decisions.choice: his house: his royal palace
decisions.reason: The word means a house, a household or a family. Here it is the palace that Hiram's builders made for David of cedar (5:11). The whole chapter turns on this word: David lives in a house (verses 1-2); he wants to build a house for Yahweh, that is, a temple (verses 5-7, 13); and Yahweh promises instead to make a house for David, a line of kings descended from him (verses 11, 16, 27, 29).

decisions.choice: Yahweh had given him rest: freedom from attack by the enemies around him
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 12:10-11 promised that when Yahweh gave Israel rest from all the enemies around them, he would choose a place for his name and they would bring their offerings there. With that rest now given, David begins to think of a house for Yahweh (compare 1 Kings 5:18-19).

decisions.choice: house (Literal, Balanced); palace (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the one word "house" all through the chapter so that the reader can follow the play on it (m1). Readable says "palace", "temple" or "family" where the sense is clear, and keeps "house" where the play itself is the point.

decisions.choice: King David; rest from war
decisions.reason: Readable names David and says what the rest was rest from. It also starts a new sentence instead of leading into verse 2.

decisions.choice: la maison (L, B, all through the chapter); le palais (R) for David's palace only
decisions.reason: French "maison" carries the same play as the Hebrew: a palace, a temple and a royal family (verses 5, 11, 13, 16). Literal and Balanced keep the one word, as the English does; Readable says "palais" where the building is meant and keeps "maison" with an explanation where the family is meant.

decisions.choice: "casa" (L, B); "palacio" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Literal and Balanced keep the one word "casa" through the chapter, so that David's house, God's house and the promised "house" (a royal line) stay one word in Spanish as in Hebrew; Readable says "palacio" here.

decisions.choice: nyumba (Literal, Balanced); jumba la kifalme, hekalu, jamaa (Readable where the sense is clear)
decisions.reason: Swahili "nyumba" means both a building and a family line ("nyumba ya Daudi"), so Literal and Balanced keep the one word through the chapter and the play on it (m1) comes through as in Hebrew. Readable says which is meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "cung" (L, B); "cung điện" (R) for "his house"
decisions.reason: The king's house is his palace (meaning decision); Vietnamese "cung" keeps the one word "house" short, while verse 5 and 11 keep "nhà" where the Lord plays on the word.

decisions.choice: Literal leaves verse 1 open ("... 때,") to run into verse 2, as the English Literal does; Balanced closes it with "... 때였다"
alternatives: one closed sentence at every level
decisions.reason: Korean can carry a time clause across the verse break only at Literal; Balanced closes each verse as its own sentence.

decisions.choice: uma casa (L, B, every time); palácio, templo, família (R where the English Readable says so)
decisions.reason: The whole chapter turns on the one word (m1): David's house, the house he wants to build for God (verse 5), the house God will make for him, a line of kings (verse 11), and the house his son will build (verse 13). Portuguese "casa" carries all of these, the family and the dynasty as well as the building ("a casa de Davi", "a casa de Bragança"), so Literal and Balanced keep "casa" every time, and Readable follows the English Readable, saying "palácio", "templo" or "família" where the sense is plain and keeping "casa" with its meaning added where the play matters (verses 5, 11, 13, 27). Decided here for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: a house of cedar: a costly royal building
decisions.reason: Cedar was a fine timber brought from Lebanon (5:11; 1 Kings 5:20). A house paneled with it was a mark of royal wealth (Jeremiah 22:14-15).

decisions.choice: inside the curtain: in a tent
decisions.reason: The word names the cloth of a tent, its curtains or hangings (Exodus 26:1). The ark was kept in the tent David had pitched for it in Jerusalem (6:17).

decisions.choice: I am dwelling ... the ark dwells: one verb for both
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for the king living in his house and the ark staying in a tent. David does not say what he plans, but the contrast makes it plain: he wants to build a house for the ark, and Nathan understands him that way (verse 3).

decisions.choice: Nathan the prophet: a prophet at David's court
decisions.reason: This is Nathan's first appearance. He will later bring Yahweh's judgment to David (12:1-15) and help to make Solomon king (1 Kings 1:11-45).

decisions.choice: in a tent
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "tent" for the tent cloth, which is what is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: David says "ta" and "ông" to Nathan; Nathan says "vua" and "tôi"
decisions.reason: The king speaks to an older prophet with respect; Nathan calls David "vua", as the Samuel terms note sets.

decisions.choice: The king speaks to the prophet Nathan in the plain style at Literal and in the semi-formal 하오체 at Balanced and Readable; Nathan answers in 합쇼체 with "임금님"
alternatives: the plain style (해라체) at every level
decisions.reason: Nathan is the king's subject but also the bearer of God's word; 하오체 is the traditional register of a king speaking with respect to an elder or counsellor.

decisions.choice: "예언자" for *navi*
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide and the Samuel terms note: the modern word, with the older church word as the alternative.

decisions.choice: o profeta Natã; Veja (você)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Natã", the usual Brazilian form, the same name as David's son in 5:14; "o profeta Natã", with the title before the name, as Portuguese says it. The king speaks to the prophet with "você" ("Veja"), as the king speaks to his subjects.

decisions.choice: all that is in your heart: all that you intend
decisions.reason: The heart is where a person thinks and plans, not only where he feels (1 Samuel 14:7).

decisions.choice: Nathan gives his own approval
decisions.reason: Nathan answers from his own judgment, without a word from Yahweh. That same night Yahweh speaks to him and turns David's plan another way (verses 4-7). Even a true prophet's own opinion is not the same as Yahweh's word.

decisions.choice: Yahweh is with you
decisions.reason: The words sum up David's story so far: Yahweh was with him from the time he was anointed (1 Samuel 16:18; 18:14; 2 Samuel 5:10).

decisions.choice: whatever you are planning
decisions.reason: Readable puts the idiom of the heart in plain words.

decisions.choice: você (Nathan to the king)

Other passages where Nathan speaks to David (chapter 12) should follow the same choice.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the verse to what comes before with a plain "and". Balanced and Readable say "But", because Yahweh's word overturns Nathan's quick approval.

decisions.choice: Verse 4 is closed as a sentence in Korean before God's words in verse 5
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb of speaking at the end; closing the verse keeps verse 5's words under their own number.

records.literal_gloss: Go and you will say to my servant, to David, Thus says Yahweh, [Is it] you [who] will build for me a house for my dwelling?

en.L: "Go and say to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave, to David, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Will you build {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to dwell in?
en.B: "Go and tell {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Are you the one to build {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house to live in?
en.R: "Go and tell {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Are you the one who will build a house for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to live in?

es.L: «Ve y di a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, a David: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: ¿Me edificarás tú casa en que yo habite?
es.B: «Ve y dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: ¿Eres tú quien me va a construir una casa para que yo viva en ella?
es.R: «Ve y dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: ¿Eres tú el que me va a construir una casa donde yo viva?

fr.L: « Va et dis à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, à David : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Est-ce toi qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} bâtiras une maison pour que j’y habite ?
fr.B: « Va dire à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Est-ce toi qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} bâtiras une maison pour que j’y habite ?
fr.R: « Va dire à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Est-ce toi qui vas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} construire une maison pour que j’y habite ?

sw.L: "Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Daudi, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Je, wewe utanijengea nyumba ya kukaa?
sw.B: "Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi, 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Je, wewe ndiwe utakayenijengea nyumba ya kuishi?
sw.R: "Nenda ukamwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Je, wewe ndiwe utakayenijengea nyumba ya kuishi?

vi.L: "Hãy đi nói với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, với Đa-vít: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ngươi là người sẽ xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà để {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở sao?
vi.B: "Hãy đi nói với Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Có phải con là người sẽ xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà để ở không?
vi.R: "Hãy đi nói với Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Có phải con là người sẽ xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà để ở không?

ko.L: "가서 내 종, 다윗에게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 네가 나를 위하여 내가 살 집을 짓겠느냐?
ko.B: "가서 내 종 다윗에게 말하여라. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 네가 내가 살 집을 지어 주겠다는 말이냐?
ko.R: "가서 내 종 다윗에게 말하여라. '이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다. 네가 나를 위해 내가 살 집을 짓겠다는 것이냐?

pt.L: "Vai e dize ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} escravo, a Davi: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Acaso tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} edificarás uma casa para {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} habitação?
pt.B: "Vai e dize ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Davi: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: És tu quem vai construir para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} uma casa onde eu possa morar?
pt.R: "Vai e dize ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Davi: 'É isto o que diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Será que és tu quem vai construir uma casa para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, para eu morar nela?

decisions.choice: my servant David: one who belongs to Yahweh and acts for him
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for a slave, a person who belongs to a master. As a title from Yahweh it is an honor, given to Moses (Numbers 12:7) and to Joshua (Joshua 24:29). It marks David as the one who serves Yahweh as king, under his authority.

decisions.choice: Will you build me a house?: you are not the one to do it
decisions.reason: The question puts the word "you" first, and the answer it expects is no. The parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:4 says it outright: "You will not build me the house." Verse 13 names the one who will build it.

decisions.choice: a house for me to dwell in
decisions.reason: A temple was thought of as a god's dwelling. Yahweh does not refuse a house for his name (verse 13), but he will not be housed at David's wish; Solomon himself says that the heavens cannot contain him (1 Kings 8:27).

decisions.choice: my slave (Literal); my servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the terms used for these books: Literal keeps the hard edge of the word, and Balanced and Readable say "servant", the usual sense of a title of honor (m1).

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (Literal); The LORD says this (Balanced); This is what the LORD says (Readable)
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula for introducing Yahweh's words keeps one wording at each level in these books.

decisions.choice: Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR (L); Le SEIGNEUR dit ceci (B); Voici ce que dit le SEIGNEUR (R)
alternatives: Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel: the prophet's formula keeps one wording at each level, as the English does. God speaking of himself takes the deity pronoun span on "mon", "me", "moi", not on "je".

decisions.choice: "Así dice el SEÑOR" (L); "El SEÑOR dice esto" (B); "Esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel, the prophet's formula keeps one wording at each level, following the three English wordings of the Samuel terms note. God's own "my servant" is "siervo" at every level, as the Samuel terms note sets for Spanish.

decisions.choice: BWANA asema hivi (Literal); Hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo (Balanced); Hili ndilo BWANA analosema (Readable)
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula keeps one wording at each level in these books, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này" (L); "CHÚA phán như vầy" (B); "Đây là lời CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: One wording at each level for the messenger formula, as the Samuel and Chronicles terms note sets in English, used through these books.

decisions.choice: God calls David "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Genesis note sets for God speaking to a person; the Lord speaks to David as a father to a son (verse 14).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다" (R) for *koh amar YHWH*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets one wording per level for the messenger formula; the older Korean form is archaic.

decisions.choice: "내 종 다윗" at every level; God speaks in the plain style (해라체) with "나" and "너"
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note and the Samuel terms note: a named servant of God is "종" at every level, and God speaks 해라체.

decisions.choice: tu (the LORD to Nathan and, through him, to David)
decisions.reason: God speaks to his prophet, and in the message to David, with "tu" ("Vai e dize", "És tu"), as he speaks to one person throughout the Portuguese Old Testament.

decisions.choice: o meu escravo (L), o meu servo (B, R); Assim diz o SENHOR (L, B), É isto o que diz o SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: "Escravo" at Literal and "servo" at Balanced and Readable, as the English and the book-wide rule for the word. The prophet's formula keeps the wording of 1 Samuel 10:18 and 15:2 in Portuguese at each level.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ בְּבַ֔יִת לְ֠מִיּוֹם הַעֲלֹתִ֞י אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְעַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וָאֶֽהְיֶה֙ מִתְהַלֵּ֔ךְ בְּאֹ֖הֶל וּבְמִשְׁכָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: For not I have dwelt in a house from [the] day I brought up [the] sons of Israel from Egypt, and until the day the this, and I have been going about in a tent and in a tabernacle.

en.L: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought up the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel from Egypt until this day, but I have been moving about in a tent and in a tabernacle.
en.B: I have not lived in a house from the day I brought the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} up from Egypt until this day. I have been moving from place to place in a tent, in a tabernacle.
en.R: I have not lived in a house since the day I brought the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} up out of Egypt. All this time I have moved from place to place in a tent, the tabernacle.

es.L: Porque no he habitado en casa desde el día en que hice subir a los hijos de Israel de Egipto hasta este día, sino que he andado en una tienda y en un tabernáculo.
es.B: No he vivido en una casa desde el día en que saqué de Egipto a los israelitas hasta el día de hoy. He andado de un lugar a otro en una tienda, en un tabernáculo.
es.R: No he vivido en una casa desde el día en que saqué a los israelitas de Egipto. Todo este tiempo he ido de un lugar a otro en una tienda, el tabernáculo.

fr.L: Car je n’ai pas habité dans une maison depuis le jour où j’ai fait monter d’Égypte les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël jusqu’à ce jour, mais j’ai circulé sous une tente et dans une demeure.
fr.B: Je n’ai pas habité de maison depuis le jour où j’ai fait monter d’Égypte les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} jusqu’à aujourd’hui. Je me suis déplacé d’un lieu à l’autre sous une tente, dans une Demeure.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas habité dans une maison depuis le jour où j’ai fait sortir d’Égypte les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Pendant tout ce temps, je me suis déplacé d’un endroit à l’autre sous une tente, la tente sacrée.

sw.L: Kwa maana sijakaa katika nyumba tangu siku nilipowapandisha wana wa Israeli kutoka Misri mpaka siku hii ya leo, bali nimekuwa nikitembea katika hema na katika maskani.
sw.B: Sijaishi katika nyumba tangu siku nilipowapandisha Waisraeli kutoka Misri mpaka leo. Nimekuwa nikihama mahali hadi mahali katika hema, katika maskani.
sw.R: Sijaishi katika nyumba tangu siku nilipowatoa Waisraeli Misri. Muda wote huu nimekuwa nikihama mahali hadi mahali katika hema, yaani maskani.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không ở trong nhà từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi Ai Cập cho đến ngày nay, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi đây đi đó trong lều và trong đền tạm.
vi.B: Ta không ở trong nhà từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lên khỏi Ai Cập cho đến ngày nay. Ta đã đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác trong một cái lều, trong đền tạm.
vi.R: Từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề ở trong nhà. Suốt thời gian ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi từ nơi này đến nơi khác trong một cái lều, tức là đền tạm.

ko.L: 나는 이스라엘 자손을 이집트에서 올라오게 한 날부터 오늘까지 집에 살지 않았고, 장막과 성막을 [거처로 삼아] 옮겨 다녔다.
ko.B: 나는 이스라엘 자손을 이집트에서 이끌어 올린 날부터 오늘까지 집에서 산 적이 없다. 나는 장막, 곧 성막에 머물며 이곳저곳으로 옮겨 다녔다.
ko.R: 나는 이스라엘 자손을 이집트에서 데리고 나온 날부터 지금까지 집에서 살지 않았다. 그동안 나는 성막이라는 천막에 머물며 이곳저곳 옮겨 다녔다.

pt.L: Porque não habitei numa casa desde o dia em que fiz subir os filhos de Israel do Egito até este dia, mas tenho andado de um lugar para outro numa tenda e num tabernáculo.
pt.B: Não morei numa casa desde o dia em que tirei os israelitas do Egito até hoje. Tenho andado de lugar em lugar numa tenda, num tabernáculo.
pt.R: Eu não morei numa casa desde o dia em que tirei os israelitas do Egito. Todo esse tempo andei de lugar em lugar numa tenda, o tabernáculo.

decisions.choice: in a tent and in a tabernacle: in the portable sanctuary
decisions.reason: Both words name the one sanctuary made in the wilderness: "tent" for its covering and "tabernacle", which means dwelling place, for the place where Yahweh dwelt among his people (Exodus 26:1, 7; 40:34-35).

decisions.choice: I have been moving about: Yahweh went with his people
decisions.reason: The verb means to walk or go about. Yahweh used it in his promise to walk among Israel (Leviticus 26:12; Deuteronomy 23:15). He has never been fixed in one place, but has gone wherever his people went.

decisions.choice: until this day: through all Israel's history so far
decisions.reason: The sanctuary at Shiloh is called "the house of Yahweh" in 1 Samuel 1:7, 24 and had doors (1 Samuel 3:15), but it was still the tent sanctuary (Psalm 78:60). Yahweh's point is that he has never asked for a house to be built (verse 7).

decisions.choice: moving from place to place
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what Yahweh's "going about" means.

decisions.choice: les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Israël (L); les {{gender:Israélites|fils d'Israël}} (B, R)
alternatives: les fils d'Israël with no setting
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list sets for "the sons of Israel": the inclusive wording by default, the traditional one as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list: Spanish "hijos" already takes in daughters, and "israelitas" is inclusive, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (Literal); Waisraeli (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, "the sons of Israel" has no gender span in Swahili: "wana" already includes daughters and "Waisraeli" names the whole people.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R), with no gender setting
alternatives: "con trai Y-sơ-ra-ên" as a second wording
decisions.reason: As at 1:18: Vietnamese "con cháu" and "dân" already include men and women, so the English gender setting has no counterpart; the same holds through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: "자손" already includes daughters and sons, so the Korean has only one wording for the English setting to choose.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender setting
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As throughout the Portuguese Old Testament (1 Samuel 7:4), "filhos" already takes in daughters and "os israelitas" names the whole people, so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender setting here or in verse 7. "Tenda" and "tabernáculo" are the terms of Exodus.

source.text: בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּכָל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲדָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת־אַחַד֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֗יתִי לִרְע֛וֹת אֶת־עַמִּ֥י אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֛מָּה לֹֽא־בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: In all where I have gone about among all [the] sons of Israel, [did] a word I speak with one of [the] tribes of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, saying, Why not have you built for me a house of cedars?

en.L: In all [places] where I have moved about among all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, did I speak a word with one of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to shepherd {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel, saying, "Why have you not built {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house of cedar?"'
en.B: Wherever I have moved about among all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, did I ever say a word to any of the tribes of Israel that I commanded to shepherd {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel, asking, "Why have you not built {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house of cedar?"'
en.R: In all the places I went with the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, I never said to any of Israel's tribes, whom I told to care for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel like a shepherd, "Why have you not built {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a house made of cedar?"'

es.L: En todo [lugar] por donde he andado con todos los hijos de Israel, ¿hablé yo palabra a alguna de las tribus de Israel, a la que mandé pastorear a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, diciendo: ‘¿Por qué no me han edificado una casa de cedro?’?”.
es.B: Dondequiera que he andado entre todos los israelitas, ¿dije alguna vez una palabra a alguna de las tribus de Israel a las que mandé pastorear a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel, preguntando: ‘¿Por qué no me han construido una casa de cedro?’?”.
es.R: En todos los lugares adonde fui con los israelitas, nunca les dije a las tribus de Israel, a las que mandé cuidar de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel como un pastor: ‘¿Por qué no me han construido una casa de cedro?’”.

fr.L: Partout où j’ai circulé parmi tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, ai-je dit un mot à une seule des tribus d’Israël à qui j’avais commandé de faire paître {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël, en disant : ‘Pourquoi ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez-vous pas bâti une maison de cèdre ?’”
fr.B: Partout où je me suis déplacé parmi tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, ai-je jamais dit un mot à l’une des tribus d’Israël que j’avais chargées de faire paître {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël, pour lui demander : ‘Pourquoi ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez-vous pas bâti une maison de cèdre ?’”
fr.R: Dans tous les endroits où je suis allé avec les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, je n’ai jamais dit à aucune des tribus d’Israël, que j’avais chargées de prendre soin de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël comme un berger : ‘Pourquoi ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez-vous pas construit une maison en cèdre ?’”

sw.L: Katika [mahali] pote nilipotembea kati ya wana wote wa Israeli, je, nilisema neno na mmoja wa makabila ya Israeli, niliyemwamuru kuwachunga watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli, nikisema, "Kwa nini hamjanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?"'
sw.B: Popote nilipotembea kati ya Waisraeli wote, je, niliwahi kusema neno na kabila lolote la Israeli nililoliamuru kuwachunga watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli, nikiuliza, "Kwa nini hamjanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?"'
sw.R: Katika mahali pote nilipokwenda pamoja na Waisraeli, sikuwahi kumwambia kabila lolote la Israeli, nililoliagiza kuwatunza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli kama mchungaji, "Kwa nini hamjanijengea nyumba ya mierezi?"'

vi.L: Ở mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi giữa toàn thể con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có nói một lời nào với một trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên, là chi tộc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền chăn dắt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rằng: "Sao các ngươi không xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà bằng gỗ bá hương?" không?'
vi.B: Ở bất cứ nơi nào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi cùng toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, có bao giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với một chi tộc nào của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền chăn dắt dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rằng: "Sao các ngươi không xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà bằng gỗ bá hương?" không?'
vi.R: Ở mọi nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đi cùng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề nói với chi tộc nào của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bảo phải chăm sóc dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như người chăn chiên: "Sao các ngươi không xây cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một ngôi nhà bằng gỗ bá hương?"'

ko.L: 내가 이스라엘 모든 자손 가운데 옮겨 다닌 모든 곳에서, 내가 내 백성 이스라엘을 목자로서 돌보라고 명령한 이스라엘 지파들 가운데 어느 하나에게 '어찌하여 너희는 나를 위하여 백향목 집을 짓지 않았느냐?' 하고 한마디라도 말한 적이 있느냐?'
ko.B: 내가 이스라엘 자손과 함께 옮겨 다닌 모든 곳에서, 내 백성 이스라엘을 목자처럼 돌보라고 명령한 이스라엘 지파들 가운데 어느 지파에게라도 '왜 나에게 백향목 집을 지어 주지 않느냐?' 하고 말한 적이 있느냐?'
ko.R: 나는 이스라엘 자손과 함께 여러 곳을 다녔다. 나는 이스라엘 지파들에게 내 백성 이스라엘을 목자처럼 돌보라고 명령했다. 그러나 그 가운데 어느 지파에게도 '왜 나에게 백향목으로 집을 지어 주지 않느냐?' 하고 말한 적이 없다.'

pt.L: Em todos [os lugares] por onde andei entre todos os filhos de Israel, falei eu alguma palavra a alguma das tribos de Israel, a quem ordenei que apascentasse o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel, dizendo: "Por que vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} edificaram uma casa de cedro?"'
pt.B: Por onde quer que eu tenha andado com todos os israelitas, alguma vez eu disse uma palavra sequer a alguma das tribos de Israel a quem ordenei que apascentasse o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel, perguntando: "Por que vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} construíram uma casa de cedro?"'
pt.R: Em todos os lugares por onde andei com os israelitas, eu nunca disse a nenhuma das tribos de Israel, a quem mandei cuidar do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel como um pastor: "Por que vocês não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} construíram uma casa feita de cedro?"'

decisions.choice: tribes: the reading of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "one of the tribes of Israel". The parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:6 has "one of the judges of Israel", a word that differs by one letter. "Judges" fits the words that follow, "whom I commanded to shepherd my people", and verse 11 also speaks of judges. The word for "tribe" can also mean a staff or scepter, so it may stand here for those who held a ruler's staff. The translation keeps the Hebrew text; the sense in any case is Israel's leaders before David.

decisions.choice: to shepherd: to lead and care for
decisions.reason: Shepherding is a common picture of ruling a people: guiding, feeding and protecting them (5:2; Numbers 27:17).

decisions.choice: did I speak a word ...?: I never said this
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer no: Yahweh never asked any of Israel's leaders for a house of cedar.

decisions.choice: I never said to any of Israel's tribes
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies.

source.text: וְ֠עַתָּה כֹּֽה־תֹאמַ֞ר לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְדָוִ֗ד כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֨יךָ֙ מִן־הַנָּוֶ֔ה מֵאַחַ֖ר הַצֹּ֑אן לִֽהְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל־עַמִּ֖י עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And now thus you will say to my servant, to David, Thus says Yahweh of hosts, I took you from the pasture, from after the flock, to be ruler over my people, over Israel.

en.L: And now, thus you shall say to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave, to David, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, over Israel.
en.B: Now then, say this to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: I took you from the pasture, from following the sheep, to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.R: So now, tell {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant David, 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: I took you from the fields where you followed the sheep, and I made you leader of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.

es.L: Y ahora, así dirás a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, a David: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Yo te tomé del pastizal, de detrás del rebaño, para que fueras gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, sobre Israel.
es.B: Ahora pues, dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Yo te tomé del pastizal, de ir detrás de las ovejas, para que fueras gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.R: Así que ahora dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo David: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Yo te saqué de los campos donde ibas detrás de las ovejas, y te hice líder de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.

fr.L: Et maintenant, tu diras ainsi à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, à David : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Moi, je t’ai pris au pâturage, derrière le troupeau, pour que tu sois chef sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, sur Israël.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, voici ce que tu diras à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Je t’ai pris au pâturage, derrière les moutons, pour que tu sois chef sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, dis à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur David : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Je t’ai pris dans les champs où tu suivais les moutons, et j’ai fait de toi le chef de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.

sw.L: Basi sasa, hivi utamwambia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Daudi, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Mimi nilikutwaa kutoka malishoni, kutoka kufuata kondoo, uwe kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Basi sasa, mwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi hivi: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Nilikutwaa kutoka malishoni, ulipokuwa ukifuata kondoo, uwe kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.R: Basi sasa, mwambie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Daudi, 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Nilikutoa malishoni ulikokuwa ukichunga kondoo, nikakufanya kiongozi wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, ngươi hãy nói thế này với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, với Đa-vít: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem ngươi ra từ đồng cỏ, từ việc đi theo bầy chiên, để làm người lãnh đạo dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy nói với Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem con ra từ đồng cỏ, từ chỗ đi theo bầy chiên, để làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, hãy nói với Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đem con ra từ đồng cỏ, nơi con chăn chiên, và lập con làm người lãnh đạo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 너는 내 종, 다윗에게 이렇게 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 너를 목장에서, 양 떼를 따르던 데서 데려다가 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자가 되게 하였다.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 내 종 다윗에게 이렇게 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 나는 양 떼를 따라다니던 너를 목장에서 데려다가 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그러니 이제 내 종 다윗에게 말하여라. '이것은 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이다. 너는 들판에서 양 떼를 따라다녔는데, 내가 너를 데려다가 내 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세웠다.

pt.L: E agora, assim dirás ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} escravo, a Davi: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu te tomei do pasto, de trás do rebanho, para seres príncipe sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, sobre Israel.
pt.B: Agora, pois, dize isto ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Davi: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei do pasto, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses príncipe sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.
pt.R: Agora, dize ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Davi: 'É isto o que diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei dos campos onde seguias as ovelhas e te fiz chefe do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel.

decisions.choice: Yahweh of hosts: Yahweh, commander of armies
decisions.reason: "Hosts" means armies: the armies of Israel and the powers of heaven, all under Yahweh's command (1 Samuel 1:3; 17:45).

decisions.choice: from the pasture, from following the flock
decisions.reason: David was a shepherd boy when Samuel anointed him (1 Samuel 16:11; 17:15, 34). Yahweh took the one who shepherded sheep to shepherd his people (verse 7; 5:2; Psalm 78:70-71).

decisions.choice: ruler: the leader Yahweh appoints over his people
decisions.reason: The word names a leader chosen by Yahweh to rule his people for him. It was used of Saul (1 Samuel 9:16; 10:1) and of David (1 Samuel 13:14; 25:30; 2 Samuel 5:2).

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (Literal); the LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the terms used for these books. "Armies" says in today's English what "hosts" means.

decisions.choice: leader
decisions.reason: Readable says "leader" for the word for ruler, as in the terms used for these books.

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level); príncipe (L, B), chefe (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide terms of 1 Samuel in Portuguese: "Exércitos" at every level, where the English Literal keeps "hosts" (1 Samuel 1:3), and "príncipe" at Literal and Balanced and "chefe" at Readable for the leader the LORD appoints (m3; 1 Samuel 9:16; 2 Samuel 5:2).

source.text: וָאֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָאַכְרִ֥תָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤תִֽי לְךָ֙ שֵׁ֣ם גָּד֔וֹל כְּשֵׁ֥ם הַגְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I have been with you in all where you went, and I cut off all your enemies from before you, and I will make for you a great name, like [the] name of the great [ones] who [are] on the earth.

en.L: And I have been with you wherever you went, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you, and I will make for you a great name, like the name of the great ones who [are] on the earth.
en.B: Wherever you have gone, I have been with you, and I have cut off all your enemies in front of you. Now I will make your name great, like the names of the greatest people on earth.
en.R: I have been with you everywhere you went. I have destroyed all your enemies as you faced them. Now I will make you famous, like the most famous people in the world.

es.L: Y he estado contigo dondequiera que has ido, y he exterminado delante de ti a todos tus enemigos, y te haré un gran nombre, como el nombre de los grandes que [hay] en la tierra.
es.B: Dondequiera que has ido, yo he estado contigo, y he destruido a todos tus enemigos delante de ti. Ahora haré grande tu nombre, como el nombre de los más grandes de la tierra.
es.R: He estado contigo en todos los lugares adonde has ido. He destruido a todos tus enemigos cuando te enfrentaban. Ahora te haré famoso, como las personas más famosas del mundo.

fr.L: Et j’ai été avec toi partout où tu es allé, et j’ai retranché tous tes ennemis devant toi, et je te ferai un grand nom, comme le nom des grands qui [sont] sur la terre.
fr.B: Partout où tu es allé, j’ai été avec toi, et j’ai anéanti tous tes ennemis devant toi. Maintenant, je rendrai ton nom grand, comme le nom des plus grands de la terre.
fr.R: J’ai été avec toi partout où tu es allé. J’ai détruit tous tes ennemis quand tu les affrontais. Maintenant, je vais te rendre célèbre, comme les gens les plus célèbres du monde.

sw.L: Nami nimekuwa pamoja nawe kila ulikokwenda, nami nimewakatilia mbali adui zako wote mbele yako, nami nitakufanyia jina kuu, kama jina la wakuu walio duniani.
sw.B: Popote ulipokwenda nimekuwa pamoja nawe, nami nimewaangamiza adui zako wote mbele yako. Sasa nitalifanya jina lako kuwa kuu, kama majina ya watu wakuu kabisa duniani.
sw.R: Nimekuwa pamoja nawe kila mahali ulipokwenda. Nimewaangamiza adui zako wote ulipokabiliana nao. Sasa nitakufanya kuwa maarufu, kama watu maarufu kuliko wote duniani.

vi.L: Ta đã ở cùng ngươi bất cứ nơi nào ngươi đi, và đã diệt trừ mọi kẻ thù của ngươi khỏi trước mặt ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi một danh lớn, như danh của những người vĩ đại trên đất.
vi.B: Con đi đâu, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã diệt trừ mọi kẻ thù trước mặt con. Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho danh con lớn như danh của những người vĩ đại nhất trên đất.
vi.R: Con đi đâu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ở cùng con. Ta đã tiêu diệt mọi kẻ thù khi chúng đối đầu với con. Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho con nổi danh như những người nổi tiếng nhất trên thế giới.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 네가 가는 모든 곳에서 너와 함께 있었고, 네 앞에서 너의 모든 원수를 끊어 버렸다. 그리고 내가 땅에 있는 위대한 자들의 이름처럼 너에게 큰 이름을 만들어 주겠다.
ko.B: 네가 어디로 가든지 나는 너와 함께 있었고, 네 앞에서 너의 모든 원수를 없애 버렸다. 이제 나는 네 이름을 세상에서 가장 위대한 사람들의 이름처럼 크게 만들어 주겠다.
ko.R: 나는 네가 가는 곳마다 너와 함께 있었다. 네가 원수들과 맞설 때마다 내가 그들을 모두 없애 버렸다. 이제 나는 너를 세상에서 가장 유명한 사람들처럼 유명하게 만들어 주겠다.

pt.L: E estive contigo em tudo por onde andaste, e eliminei todos os teus inimigos de diante de ti, e farei para ti um grande nome, como o nome dos grandes que [há] na terra.
pt.B: Por onde quer que tenhas andado, eu estive contigo, e eliminei todos os teus inimigos diante de ti. Agora tornarei grande o teu nome, como o nome dos maiores da terra.
pt.R: Estive contigo em todos os lugares por onde foste. Destruí todos os teus inimigos quando enfrentaste cada um deles. Agora vou te tornar famoso, como as pessoas mais famosas do mundo.

decisions.choice: I have been, I have cut off ... and I will make: from what Yahweh has done to what he will do
alternatives: I have made for you a great name
decisions.reason: The first verbs tell what Yahweh has already done for David. With "and I will make" the verb form changes to the one used for the future, and the promises begin. Some read this verb and those in verses 10-11 as still telling the past ("I have made you a great name"), but the form and the promise in verse 11 favor the future.

decisions.choice: I will make for you a great name
decisions.reason: Yahweh made the same promise to Abram: "I will make your name great" (Genesis 12:2).

decisions.choice: cut off from before you: destroyed as they faced you
decisions.reason: Yahweh removed David's enemies one by one as David met them in battle (5:17-25; 1 Samuel 17:50).

decisions.choice: Now
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "Now" to mark where the past ends and the promises begin (m1).

decisions.choice: make you famous
decisions.reason: Readable puts "a great name" in plain words.

decisions.choice: tornarei grande o teu nome
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the words of God's promise to Abram in Genesis 12:2 in Portuguese ("tornarei grande o teu nome"), so that the echo m2 points to is heard; Readable says "famoso", as Genesis 12:2 does at Readable.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְעַמִּ֨י לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּנְטַעְתִּיו֙ וְשָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְלֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־יֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵֽי־עַוְלָה֙ לְעַנּוֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּרִאשׁוֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will appoint a place for my people, for Israel, and I will plant it, and it will dwell in its place and not be disturbed again; and not will add sons of injustice to afflict it as at the first,

en.L: And I will appoint a place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, for Israel, and I will plant it, and it will dwell in its own place and not be disturbed again; and the sons of wickedness will not again afflict it as at the first,
en.B: I will appoint a place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel and plant them there, so that they may live in their own place and not be troubled anymore. Wicked people will no longer oppress them as they did at the beginning,
en.R: I will choose a place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. I will plant them there like a tree, so that they can live in their own land and not be afraid anymore. Evil people will not hurt them again the way they did before.

es.L: Y señalaré un lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, para Israel, y lo plantaré, y habitará en su propio lugar y no será perturbado más; y los hijos de iniquidad no volverán a afligirlo como al principio,
es.B: Señalaré un lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel y los plantaré allí, para que vivan en su propio lugar y no sean molestados nunca más. La gente malvada ya no los oprimirá como lo hizo al principio,
es.R: Escogeré un lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Los plantaré allí como a un árbol, para que puedan vivir en su propia tierra y ya no tengan miedo. La gente malvada no volverá a hacerles daño como antes.

fr.L: Et je fixerai un lieu pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, pour Israël, et je le planterai, et il habitera à sa place et ne sera plus troublé ; et les fils d’iniquité ne recommenceront plus à l’opprimer comme au commencement,
fr.B: Je fixerai un lieu pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël et je l’y planterai, pour qu’il habite chez lui et ne soit plus inquiété. Les méchants ne l’opprimeront plus comme ils l’ont fait au début,
fr.R: Je choisirai un endroit pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Je l’y planterai comme un arbre, pour qu’il puisse vivre dans son propre pays sans avoir peur. Les méchants ne lui feront plus de mal comme avant.

sw.L: Nami nitawawekea watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli mahali, nami nitawapanda, nao watakaa mahali pao wenyewe wasisumbuliwe tena; wala wana wa uovu hawataongeza kuwatesa kama hapo kwanza,
sw.B: Nitawachagulia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli mahali na kuwapanda huko, ili wakae mahali pao wenyewe wasisumbuliwe tena. Watu waovu hawatawaonea tena kama walivyofanya hapo mwanzo,
sw.R: Nitawachagulia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli mahali. Nitawapanda huko kama mti, ili waishi katika nchi yao wenyewe wasiogope tena. Watu waovu hawatawaumiza tena kama walivyofanya zamani.

vi.L: Ta sẽ định một chỗ cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, và sẽ trồng nó, để nó ở tại chỗ của mình và không còn bị khuấy rối nữa; và con cái gian ác sẽ không còn hà hiếp nó như thuở trước,
vi.B: Ta sẽ định một chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và trồng họ tại đó, để họ được sống ở chỗ của mình và không còn bị quấy nhiễu nữa. Kẻ gian ác sẽ không còn áp bức họ như thuở ban đầu,
vi.R: Ta sẽ chọn một chỗ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ trồng họ ở đó như trồng một cây, để họ được sống trong xứ của mình và không còn phải sợ hãi nữa. Kẻ ác sẽ không còn làm hại họ như trước kia nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 백성 이스라엘을 위하여 한 곳을 정하고 그들을 심어서, 그들이 자기 곳에 살며 다시는 흔들리지 않게 하겠다. 그리고 악한 자들이 처음처럼 다시는 그들을 괴롭히지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘이 살 곳을 정하고 그들을 거기에 심어, 그들이 자기 땅에서 살며 다시는 불안에 떨지 않게 하겠다. 악한 자들이 처음처럼 다시는 그들을 억누르지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 내 백성 이스라엘을 위해 한 곳을 정하겠다. 나무를 심듯이 그들을 거기에 심어서, 그들이 자기 땅에서 살며 더 이상 두려워하지 않게 하겠다. 악한 사람들이 전처럼 다시는 그들을 괴롭히지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: E designarei um lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, para Israel, e o plantarei, e ele habitará no seu lugar e não será mais perturbado; e os filhos da maldade não tornarão a oprimi-lo como no princípio,
pt.B: Designarei um lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel e o plantarei ali, para que viva no seu próprio lugar e não seja mais perturbado. Os perversos não voltarão a oprimi-lo como fizeram no princípio,
pt.R: Vou escolher um lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Vou plantá-lo ali como uma árvore, para que ele possa viver na sua própria terra e não tenha mais medo. Gente má não vai mais maltratá-lo como antes.

decisions.choice: a place: a land where Israel can live in safety
decisions.reason: Here the place is the land where Yahweh will plant his people. The same word is used in Deuteronomy for the place Yahweh will choose for his name (Deuteronomy 12:5), and that may be heard here too, since a temple is being spoken of; but the words "plant" and "dwell" point to the land.

decisions.choice: I will plant it: settle Israel for good
decisions.reason: Moses' song says Yahweh would plant his people on the mountain of his inheritance (Exodus 15:17; compare Psalm 44:3; 80:9). A planted people is rooted and not moved again.

decisions.choice: sons of wickedness: violent, unjust people
decisions.reason: "Sons of" a quality means people marked by it. Here it means oppressors, like those who afflicted Israel in Egypt and in the time of the judges (verse 11).

decisions.choice: not be disturbed again ... as at the first
decisions.reason: The sentence goes on into verse 11: "as at the first, and from the day I appointed judges". "At the first" is the oppression in Egypt; verse 11 adds the troubles of the time of the judges.

decisions.choice: plant them there like a tree; not be afraid
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture in "plant" plain and says what being "disturbed" means for a people: living in fear. It ends the sentence here, and verse 11 picks it up.

decisions.choice: Verse 10 is closed as a sentence in Korean; verse 11 restates the time ("내가 사사들을 세운 때부터") as its own sentence
alternatives: one sentence running over the verse break
decisions.reason: Korean puts the time clause before the verb; to keep each verse's words under its number, the Korean closes verse 10 and makes verse 11's time phrase a sentence of its own, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וּלְמִן־הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַהֲנִיחֹ֥תִי לְךָ֖ מִכָּל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְהִגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־בַ֖יִת יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֥ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and from the day that I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I will give rest to you from all your enemies. And declares to you Yahweh that a house will make for you Yahweh.

en.L: and from the day that I appointed judges over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} declares to you that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make a house for you.
en.B: ever since the time I set judges over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. And I will give you rest from all your enemies. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} declares to you that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make a house for you.
en.R: They did that from the time I put judges over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel. But I will give you rest from all your enemies. And now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} tells you that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make a house for you, a family of kings who will come after you.

es.L: y desde el día en que puse jueces sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Y te daré descanso de todos tus enemigos. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te declara que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hará una casa.
es.B: desde el tiempo en que puse jueces sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Y te daré descanso de todos tus enemigos. Además, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te declara que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hará una casa.
es.R: Lo hicieron desde el tiempo en que puse jueces sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel. Pero yo te daré descanso de todos tus enemigos. Y ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dice que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te hará una casa, una familia de reyes que vendrán después de ti.

fr.L: et depuis le jour où j’ai établi des juges sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Et je te donnerai du repos face à tous tes ennemis. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’annonce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te fera une maison.
fr.B: depuis le temps où j’ai établi des juges sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Je te donnerai du repos face à tous tes ennemis. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te déclare que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te fera une maison.
fr.R: Ils l’ont fait depuis l’époque où j’ai établi des juges sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël. Mais moi, je te donnerai la paix avec tous tes ennemis. Et maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’annonce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te fera une maison, une famille de rois qui viendront après toi.

sw.L: na tangu siku ile nilipoweka waamuzi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Nami nitakupa raha kutoka kwa adui zako wote. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakutangazia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanyia nyumba.
sw.B: tangu wakati nilipoweka waamuzi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Nami nitakupa raha kutoka kwa adui zako wote. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakutangazia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanyia nyumba.
sw.R: Walifanya hivyo tangu wakati nilipoweka waamuzi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli. Lakini nitakupa raha kutoka kwa adui zako wote. Na sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anakuambia kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakufanyia nyumba, yaani ukoo wa wafalme watakaokufuata.

vi.L: từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập các quan xét trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ cho ngươi được yên nghỉ khỏi mọi kẻ thù của ngươi. Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán cùng ngươi rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lập cho ngươi một nhà.
vi.B: kể từ khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập các quan xét trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ cho con được yên ổn khỏi mọi kẻ thù. Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với con rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lập cho con một nhà.
vi.R: Chúng đã làm như vậy từ thời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập các thủ lĩnh trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho con được yên ổn khỏi mọi kẻ thù. Và bây giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho con biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lập cho con một nhà, tức là một dòng dõi các vua nối tiếp con.

ko.L: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 사사들을 세운 날부터 [그러했다]. 그리고 내가 너에게 너의 모든 원수로부터 안식을 주겠다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 선언한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 위하여 집을 세우실 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 사사들을 세운 때부터 그러했다. 이제 내가 너를 모든 원수에게서 벗어나 쉬게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너에게 선언한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너를 위하여 한 집안을 세워 주겠다.
ko.R: 내가 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 사사들을 세운 때부터 그들은 그렇게 했다. 그러나 나는 너를 모든 원수에게서 벗어나 쉬게 해 주겠다. 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너에게 말한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 너를 위해 한 집안을 세워 주겠다. 네 뒤를 이어 왕이 될 자손들을 주겠다.

pt.L: e desde o dia em que ordenei juízes sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. E te darei descanso de todos os teus inimigos. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te declara que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te fará uma casa.
pt.B: desde o tempo em que estabeleci juízes sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. E eu te darei descanso de todos os teus inimigos. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te declara que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te fará uma casa.
pt.R: Eles fizeram isso desde o tempo em que coloquei juízes sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo Israel. Mas eu vou te dar descanso de todos os teus inimigos. E agora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te diz que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vai te fazer uma casa, uma família de reis que virão depois de ti.

decisions.choice: a house: a family line of kings
decisions.reason: Here the play on the word turns. David wanted to build Yahweh a house of cedar; Yahweh will make David a house of a different kind, a family of descendants who will sit on his throne (verse 16). The verb is "make", not "build" as in verse 5, though David will say "build" in verse 27.

decisions.choice: Yahweh declares to you that Yahweh will make: the oracle names the speaker
decisions.reason: Yahweh has been speaking as "I", but here the message names him twice by name. The change sets this promise apart as the center of the message.

decisions.choice: I will give you rest from all your enemies
decisions.reason: Verse 1 said that Yahweh had given David rest. Here it is promised for the time to come: the rest he has will last. Those who read verses 9-11 as telling the past read it "I have given you rest" (see verse 9).

decisions.choice: judges: Israel's leaders before the kings
decisions.reason: The judges were the leaders Yahweh raised up to rescue Israel from its enemies, from after Joshua to Samuel (Judges 2:16-18; 1 Samuel 7:15).

decisions.choice: a house, a family of kings who will come after you
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the word "house" for the play on it and adds what it means here (m1).

decisions.choice: They did that from the time
decisions.reason: Readable ended verse 10 with a full stop, so it starts a new sentence here that links back to the oppression.

decisions.choice: "một nhà" at every level (R adds "tức là một dòng dõi các vua nối tiếp con")
decisions.reason: The promise plays on "house" as building and as royal line (meaning decision); Vietnamese "nhà" carries both, as in "nhà Đa-vít", so every level keeps it, and Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: God names himself in the third person without the honorific at Balanced and Readable ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 ... 세워 주겠다"); Literal keeps the honorific of the narrator's frame
decisions.reason: In Korean a speaker does not honor himself; when God speaks of himself by name, Balanced and Readable drop the honorific particle so the words are clearly his own.

decisions.choice: uma casa (every level); uma família de reis (R, added)
decisions.reason: Here the play on "casa" turns (m1): David wanted to build God a house, and God will make David a house of kings. Portuguese "casa" can name a royal line, so every level keeps the one word, and Readable adds what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: כִּ֣י׀יִמְלְא֣וּ יָמֶ֗יךָ וְשָֽׁכַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲקִימֹתִ֤י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵצֵ֖א מִמֵּעֶ֑יךָ וַהֲכִינֹתִ֖י אֶת־מַמְלַכְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: When are full your days and you lie down with your fathers, and I will raise up your seed after you, who will come out from your inward parts, and I will establish his kingdom.

en.L: When your days are full and you lie down with your fathers, I will raise up your offspring after you, who will come out from your body, and I will establish his kingdom.
en.B: When your days are complete and you rest with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring after you, one who will come from your own body, and I will make his kingdom firm.
en.R: When your life is over and you die, I will make one of your own sons king after you. I will make his kingdom strong.

es.L: Cuando se cumplan tus días y te acuestes con tus padres, levantaré después de ti a tu descendencia, que saldrá de tus entrañas, y afirmaré su reino.
es.B: Cuando se cumplan tus días y descanses con tus antepasados, levantaré después de ti a tu descendiente, uno que saldrá de tu propio cuerpo, y haré firme su reino.
es.R: Cuando tu vida termine y mueras, haré rey después de ti a uno de tus propios hijos. Haré fuerte su reino.

fr.L: Quand tes jours seront accomplis et que tu te coucheras avec tes pères, je susciterai ta descendance après toi, celui qui sortira de tes entrailles, et j’affermirai sa royauté.
fr.B: Quand tes jours seront achevés et que tu reposeras avec tes ancêtres, je susciterai après toi ta descendance, quelqu’un qui sera issu de toi, et j’affermirai son royaume.
fr.R: Quand ta vie sera finie et que tu mourras, je ferai roi après toi un de tes propres fils. Je rendrai son royaume solide.

sw.L: Siku zako zitakapotimia nawe utalala pamoja na baba zako, nitauinua uzao wako baada yako, atakayetoka katika viuno vyako, nami nitauimarisha ufalme wake.
sw.B: Siku zako zitakapotimia nawe ukapumzika pamoja na babu zako, nitamwinua mzao wako baada yako, atakayetoka katika mwili wako mwenyewe, nami nitauimarisha ufalme wake.
sw.R: Maisha yako yatakapokwisha nawe ukafa, nitamfanya mmoja wa wana wako mwenyewe kuwa mfalme baada yako. Nitaufanya ufalme wake kuwa imara.

vi.L: Khi các ngày của ngươi đã mãn và ngươi nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy dòng dõi ngươi lên sau ngươi, là người sẽ ra từ thân thể ngươi, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập vững vương quốc của người ấy.
vi.B: Khi những ngày của con đã trọn và con an nghỉ với tổ tiên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ dấy dòng dõi con lên nối ngôi con, là người do chính con sinh ra, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho vương quốc người ấy vững bền.
vi.R: Khi đời con đã hết và con qua đời, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho một người con trai của chính con lên làm vua kế vị con. Ta sẽ làm cho vương quốc người ấy vững mạnh.

ko.L: 네 날이 차서 네가 네 조상들과 함께 누우면, 내가 네 뒤에 네 몸에서 나올 네 씨를 일으켜 세우고, 그의 나라를 굳게 세우겠다.
ko.B: 네 날이 다 차서 네가 조상들과 함께 잠들면, 내가 네 몸에서 날 네 자손을 네 뒤에 세우고 그의 나라를 튼튼하게 하겠다.
ko.R: 네가 죽으면, 나는 네 아들 가운데 하나를 네 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세우겠다. 그리고 그의 나라를 강하게 하겠다.

pt.L: Quando os teus dias se completarem e tu te deitares com os teus pais, levantarei depois de ti a tua descendência, que sairá das tuas entranhas, e estabelecerei o seu reino.
pt.B: Quando os teus dias chegarem ao fim e descansares com os teus antepassados, levantarei depois de ti a tua descendência, um que será gerado do teu próprio corpo, e firmarei o seu reino.
pt.R: Quando a tua vida terminar e morreres, eu farei um dos teus próprios filhos rei depois de ti. E vou tornar forte o reino dele.

decisions.choice: your days are full and you lie down with your fathers: you die
decisions.reason: "To lie down with one's fathers" is the usual way these books speak of a king's death (1 Kings 2:10; 11:43).

decisions.choice: your offspring: first one son, and through him a line
decisions.reason: The word means seed, and so offspring. It can mean one descendant or a whole line of them. Here it is first one son, who will build the house (verse 13) and whom Yahweh will correct (verse 14): Solomon, who applies these words to himself (1 Kings 5:19; 8:19-20). But the promise reaches on to the whole line that follows (verse 16).

decisions.choice: who will come out from your body
decisions.reason: Yahweh used the same words in his promise to Abram of a son not yet born (Genesis 15:4). Solomon too is not yet born; his birth is told in 12:24.

decisions.choice: I will raise up: bring forward and set in place
decisions.reason: The verb is used for Yahweh setting a leader in place for his people (Judges 2:16; 1 Samuel 2:35).

decisions.choice: rest with your ancestors
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the wording kept for this phrase in these books; Readable says simply "die".

decisions.choice: I will make one of your own sons king after you
decisions.reason: Readable names what the offspring is in this verse, a son, and what being raised up means for him, becoming king. Verse 16 carries the promise on to the whole line.

decisions.choice: te coucher avec tes pères (L); reposer avec tes ancêtres (B); mourir (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel, the death formula keeps one wording at each level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "te acuestes con tus padres" (L); "descanses con tus antepasados" (B); "tu descendencia" (L), "tu descendiente" (B)
decisions.reason: The death formula follows the Samuel terms note's three wordings. Literal keeps the collective "descendencia" for zeraʿ; Balanced says "descendiente", one son, since the next verse speaks of "him".

decisions.choice: "nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình" (L); "an nghỉ với tổ tiên" (B); "qua đời" (R)
decisions.reason: The death formula of the Samuel and Chronicles terms note (lay down / rested / died), kept at each level through these books.

decisions.choice: "씨" (L), "자손" (B) for *zeraʿ*; Readable "네 아들 가운데 하나"
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note for *zeraʿ*; Readable follows the English Readable.

decisions.choice: que sairá das tuas entranhas (L); gerado do teu próprio corpo (B); estabelecerei (L), firmarei (B)
decisions.reason: The words of God's promise of a son to Abram (m3) keep the wording of Genesis 15:4 in Portuguese at Literal and Balanced. "Estabelecer" (L) and "firmar" (B) are the verbs used for the same word in 5:12 and verses 13, 16 and 24, so that the reader can follow it through the chapter.

source.text: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה־בַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י וְכֹנַנְתִּ֛י אֶת־כִּסֵּ֥א מַמְלַכְתּ֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish [the] throne of his kingdom until forever.

en.L: He will build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
en.B: He is the one who will build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I will make the throne of his kingdom firm forever.
en.R: He is the one who will build a house to be a temple that honors {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. And I will make sure that his throne as king will last forever.

es.L: Él edificará una casa a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y yo afirmaré el trono de su reino para siempre.
es.B: Él es quien edificará una casa para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y yo haré firme el trono de su reino para siempre.
es.R: Él es quien construirá una casa que será un templo para honrar {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Y yo haré que su trono como rey dure para siempre.

fr.L: C’est lui qui bâtira une maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et j’affermirai le trône de sa royauté pour toujours.
fr.B: C’est lui qui bâtira une maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et j’affermirai pour toujours le trône de son royaume.
fr.R: C’est lui qui construira une maison, un temple pour honorer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Et je ferai en sorte que son trône de roi dure pour toujours.

sw.L: Yeye atajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nami nitakiimarisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake milele.
sw.B: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nami nitakiimarisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wake milele.
sw.R: Yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba, yaani hekalu la kuliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Nami nitahakikisha kwamba kiti chake cha enzi kitadumu milele.

vi.L: Chính người ấy sẽ xây một nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập vững ngai vương quốc người đến đời đời.
vi.B: Chính người ấy sẽ xây một ngôi nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngai vương quốc người vững bền đời đời.
vi.R: Chính người ấy sẽ xây một ngôi nhà làm đền thờ để tôn vinh danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngai vua của người tồn tại đời đời.

ko.L: 그가 내 이름을 위하여 집을 지을 것이고, 나는 그의 나라의 왕좌를 영원히 굳게 세우겠다.
ko.B: 바로 그가 내 이름을 위하여 집을 지을 것이다. 그리고 나는 그의 나라의 왕좌를 영원히 튼튼하게 하겠다.
ko.R: 바로 그가 내 이름을 높이는 성전을 지을 것이다. 그리고 나는 그가 왕으로서 다스리는 일이 영원히 계속되게 하겠다.

pt.L: Ele edificará uma casa para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, e eu estabelecerei o trono do seu reino para sempre.
pt.B: É ele quem vai construir uma casa para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, e eu firmarei o trono do seu reino para sempre.
pt.R: É ele quem vai construir uma casa, um templo para honrar o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome. E eu vou fazer com que o trono dele como rei dure para sempre.

decisions.choice: he will build: he, not you
decisions.reason: The word "he" is stressed, answering verse 5: David will not build the house, but his son will (1 Kings 5:17-19; 8:18-19). 1 Chronicles 22:8 gives the reason as David's many wars.

decisions.choice: a house for my name: a temple where Yahweh makes himself known
decisions.reason: Yahweh's name stands for himself as he is known and called on. Deuteronomy speaks of the place he would choose "to put his name there" (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11), and Solomon prays that his eyes would be on the house of which he said, "My name will be there" (1 Kings 8:29). Yahweh is present there without being housed there (verse 5).

decisions.choice: forever: for all time to come
decisions.reason: The phrase looks to a time without a set end. The word comes again and again in the chapter (verses 16, 24, 25, 26, 29). When the line of kings was broken at the exile, the prophets and psalms held to this promise (Psalm 89:30, 37-38; Jeremiah 33:17), and the New Testament sees it kept in Jesus, the son of David (Luke 1:32-33).

decisions.choice: a house to be a temple
decisions.reason: Readable says that this house is a temple, keeping the word "house" for the play on it.

source.text: אֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶה־לּ֣וֹ לְאָ֔ב וְה֖וּא יִהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְבֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּהַ֣עֲוֺת֔וֹ וְהֹֽכַחְתִּיו֙ בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וּבְנִגְעֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I will be to him for a father, and he will be to me for a son. Who when he does wrong, and I will correct him with [the] rod of men and with [the] blows of [the] sons of mankind.

en.L: I will be to him a father, and he will be to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a son. When he does wrong, I will correct him with the rod of {{gender:mortals|men}} and with the blows of {{gender:the children of mankind|the sons of men}}.
en.B: I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with a rod such as people use, with blows such as human beings give.
en.R: I will be his father, and he will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} son. But if he does wrong, I will correct him. I will punish him the way people punish, with a rod and with beatings.

es.L: Yo seré para él padre, y él será para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} hijo. Cuando haga mal, lo corregiré con vara de {{gender:mortales|hombres}} y con azotes de {{gender:seres humanos|hijos de hombres}}.
es.B: Yo seré un padre para él, y él será un hijo para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Cuando haga mal, lo disciplinaré con la vara que usan las personas, con los golpes que dan los seres humanos.
es.R: Yo seré su padre, y él será {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hijo. Pero si hace algo malo, lo corregiré. Lo castigaré como castigan las personas, con vara y con golpes.

fr.L: Moi, je serai pour lui un père, et lui sera pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un fils. S’il commet une faute, je le corrigerai avec une verge d’{{gender:humains|hommes}} et avec des coups de {{gender:fils de l’humanité|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: Je serai pour lui un père, et il sera pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un fils. S’il fait le mal, je le corrigerai avec le bâton dont se servent les humains, avec les coups que donnent les gens.
fr.R: Je serai son père, et il sera {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} fils. Mais s’il fait le mal, je le corrigerai. Je le punirai comme les gens punissent, avec un bâton et avec des coups.

sw.L: Mimi nitakuwa kwake baba, naye atakuwa kwangu mwana. Atakapotenda uovu, nitamrudi kwa fimbo ya wanadamu na kwa mapigo ya wanadamu.
sw.B: Mimi nitakuwa baba yake, naye atakuwa mwanangu. Atakapokosa, nitamrudi kwa fimbo kama watu wanavyotumia, kwa mapigo kama wanadamu wanavyopiga.
sw.R: Nitakuwa baba yake, naye atakuwa mwanangu. Lakini akikosa, nitamrudi. Nitamwadhibu kama watu wanavyoadhibu, kwa fimbo na kwa mapigo.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cha người, và người sẽ làm con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi người phạm tội, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sửa phạt người bằng roi của loài người và bằng đòn vọt của con cái loài người.
vi.B: Ta sẽ là cha của người, và người sẽ là con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi người làm điều sai trái, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sửa trị người bằng roi như loài người vẫn dùng, bằng đòn vọt như con người vẫn đánh.
vi.R: Ta sẽ là cha của người, và người sẽ là con của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nhưng nếu người làm điều sai, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sửa phạt người. Ta sẽ trừng phạt người như loài người vẫn trừng phạt, bằng roi và bằng đòn.

ko.L: 나는 그에게 아버지가 되고, 그는 나에게 아들이 될 것이다. 그가 잘못을 저지르면, 내가 사람의 막대기와 인생들의 매로 그를 바로잡겠다.
ko.B: 나는 그의 아버지가 되고, 그는 나의 아들이 될 것이다. 그가 잘못을 저지르면, 사람들이 쓰는 막대기와 사람들이 때리는 매로 그를 징계하겠다.
ko.R: 나는 그의 아버지가 되고, 그는 내 아들이 될 것이다. 그러나 그가 잘못하면 나는 그를 바로잡겠다. 사람들이 벌을 주듯이 매로 때려서라도 그를 바로잡겠다.

pt.L: Eu serei para ele pai, e ele será para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} filho. Quando ele cometer iniquidade, eu o corrigirei com a vara de {{gender:mortais|homens}} e com os açoites dos {{gender:seres humanos|filhos dos homens}}.
pt.B: Eu serei pai para ele, e ele será filho para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Quando ele fizer o mal, eu o disciplinarei com uma vara como a que as pessoas usam, com golpes como os que os seres humanos dão.
pt.R: Eu serei o pai dele, e ele será o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} filho. Mas, se ele fizer o que é errado, eu o corrigirei. Vou castigá-lo como as pessoas castigam, com vara e com pancadas.

decisions.choice: I will be his father, and he will be my son: a bond of covenant care and loyalty
decisions.reason: Yahweh takes David's son into a relation like that of father and son: Yahweh will care for him, guide him and correct him, and the king is to honor and obey him and rule for him. The psalms use the same words of the king of David's line (Psalm 2:7; 89:27-28).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 1:5 quotes these words of the Son
decisions.reason: Hebrews 1:5 quotes the first half of this verse, together with Psalm 2:7, as words spoken of Jesus as the Son. In their first setting they are said of the son of David who will build the temple, and the next words expect that he may do wrong. Hebrews reads the promise to David's line as finding its fullest meaning in Jesus, the descendant of David.

decisions.choice: when he does wrong: the son may sin
decisions.reason: The promise does not say the son will be without fault; it says what Yahweh will do when he does wrong. The parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:13 does not have these words about wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: I will correct him: discipline him as a father does
decisions.reason: The verb means to rebuke or correct, with the aim of putting right. Proverbs 3:12 uses it of the same picture: Yahweh corrects the one he loves, as a father the son he delights in.

decisions.choice: the rod of men, the blows of the sons of mankind: punishment of the kind people give
alternatives: punishment by means of human enemies
decisions.reason: The words most likely mean punishment that is real but measured, as human beings punish, not destruction. Yahweh may also use human enemies for it, as he later raised up enemies against Solomon (1 Kings 11:14, 23). Compare Psalm 89:31-34.

decisions.choice: the rod of mortals; the blows of the children of mankind
decisions.reason: The words mean human beings in general, so Literal offers the inclusive wording by default with the traditional "men" and "sons of men" as the setting. Balanced and Readable say "people" and "human beings".

decisions.choice: {{gender:mortales|hombres}}; {{gender:seres humanos|hijos de hombres}}
decisions.reason: As the English Literal: the words mean human beings in general, so the inclusive "mortales", "seres humanos" is the default and the Hebrew "hombres", "hijos de hombres" the alternative; Spanish has two real wordings here.

decisions.choice: fimbo ya wanadamu; mapigo ya wanadamu
decisions.reason: The English Literal has gender spans on "mortals|men" and "the children of mankind|the sons of men". "Wanadamu" (human beings) already includes everyone, so Swahili needs no span.

decisions.choice: "loài người", "con cái loài người", with no gender setting
alternatives: "con trai loài người" as a second wording
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "men" or "mortals"; Vietnamese "loài người" and "con cái" already include all people.

decisions.choice: No gender span at Literal: "사람의 막대기와 인생들의 매"
alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: "사람" and "인생" in Korean mean human beings of either sex; there is no second wording for the setting to offer.

decisions.choice: Eu serei pai para ele, e ele será filho para mim (B)
alternatives: Eu serei o seu pai, e ele será o meu filho
decisions.reason: Hebrews 1:5 quotes these words (m2), and its Portuguese Balanced reads "Eu serei Pai para ele, e ele será Filho para mim"; Balanced here keeps the same words, so that the reader hears the quotation, with lowercase "pai" and "filho" because here they are said of David's son. Literal keeps the Hebrew order; Readable says it plainly. The deity_pronoun span is on "mim", God speaking.

decisions.choice: a vara de mortais; os açoites dos seres humanos
decisions.reason: As the English Literal: the words mean human beings in general (m5), so the inclusive wording is the default and the traditional "homens", "filhos dos homens" the alternative. Balanced and Readable say "as pessoas" and "os seres humanos", which need no setting.

source.text: וְחַסְדִּ֖י לֹא־יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֲסִרֹ֨תִי֙ מֵעִ֣ם שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And my steadfast love not will depart from him, as I removed [it] from with Saul, whom I removed from before you.

en.L: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} steadfast love will not depart from him, as I took [it] away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} faithful love will not leave him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed to make way for you.
en.R: But I will never stop showing him {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} faithful love. I will not take it away from him the way I took it from Saul, when I removed Saul to make room for you.

es.L: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor leal no se apartará de él, como [lo] quité de Saúl, al cual quité de delante de ti.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor fiel no se apartará de él, como lo aparté de Saúl, a quien quité para darte lugar a ti.
es.R: Pero nunca dejaré de mostrarle {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} amor fiel. No se lo quitaré como se lo quité a Saúl, cuando quité a Saúl para darte lugar a ti.

fr.L: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour loyal ne se retirera pas de lui, comme je l’ai retiré de Saül, que j’ai écarté de devant toi.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour fidèle ne le quittera pas, comme je l’ai retiré à Saül, que j’ai écarté pour te faire place.
fr.R: Mais je ne cesserai jamais de lui montrer {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} amour fidèle. Je ne le lui retirerai pas comme je l’ai retiré à Saül, quand j’ai écarté Saül pour te faire place.

sw.L: Lakini upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} usiokoma hautaondoka kwake, kama nilivyouondoa kwa Sauli, niliyemwondoa mbele yako.
sw.B: Lakini upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} usiokoma hautamwacha, kama nilivyouondoa kwa Sauli, niliyemwondoa ili nikupe wewe nafasi.
sw.R: Lakini sitaacha kamwe kumwonyesha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} usiokoma. Sitauondoa kwake kama nilivyouondoa kwa Sauli, nilipomwondoa Sauli ili nikupe wewe nafasi.

vi.L: Nhưng tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không lìa khỏi người, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cất [nó] khỏi Sau-lơ, là người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã loại bỏ khỏi trước mặt ngươi.
vi.B: Nhưng tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không lìa khỏi người, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cất nó khỏi Sau-lơ, là người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã loại bỏ để nhường chỗ cho con.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ thôi tỏ tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} với người. Ta sẽ không cất nó khỏi người như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cất khỏi Sau-lơ, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loại bỏ Sau-lơ để nhường chỗ cho con.

ko.L: 그러나 내가 네 앞에서 치워 버린 사울에게서 [그것을] 거두어 간 것처럼, 내 한결같은 사랑이 그에게서 떠나지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 내 인애는 그에게서 떠나지 않을 것이다. 내가 너를 위해 물리친 사울에게서는 그것을 거두었으나, 그에게서는 거두지 않겠다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 그에게 내 인애를 결코 거두지 않겠다. 나는 너에게 자리를 내주려고 사울을 물리쳤고, 그때 사울에게서 내 인애를 거두어 갔다. 그러나 네 아들에게서는 그렇게 하지 않겠다.

pt.L: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} amor leal não se afastará dele, como [o] tirei de Saul, a quem removi de diante de ti.
pt.B: Mas o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} amor leal não se afastará dele, como o tirei de Saul, a quem removi para dar lugar a ti.
pt.R: Mas eu nunca vou deixar de mostrar a ele o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} amor leal. Não vou tirá-lo dele como o tirei de Saul, quando removi Saul para abrir lugar para ti.

decisions.choice: my steadfast love: Yahweh's loyal, faithful love
decisions.reason: The word names love that keeps faith with a bond: kindness that does not let go (1 Samuel 20:14-15). Here Yahweh binds himself to David's son without condition: even when the son does wrong (verse 14), this love will not be withdrawn. Isaiah 55:3 calls it "the faithful love promised to David".

decisions.choice: as I took it from Saul, whom I removed
decisions.reason: The verb "turn aside, remove" recalls 1 Samuel 16:14, where the Spirit of Yahweh turned away from Saul, and 1 Samuel 15:23, 28, where Yahweh rejected him as king. David's son will be corrected, but not rejected as Saul was.

decisions.choice: will not depart from him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text says "my love will not depart from him"; the parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:13 and the old Greek translation have "I will not take my love away from him". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: whom I removed from before you: whom I put aside to make way for you
decisions.reason: Saul was removed so that David could take his place (1 Samuel 15:28).

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in the terms used for these books and in Exodus 34:6.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R) for God's *ḥesed*
decisions.reason: God's own faithful love takes the Psalms and Genesis word at every level; "lòng nhân từ" is kept for *ḥesed* between people (2:5).

decisions.choice: o meu amor leal (every level)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording of the Portuguese Old Testament for the LORD's hesed (m1): "amor leal", kept for God's love, while "lealdade" and "bondade leal" name kindness between people (1 Samuel 15:6). One wording serves all three levels, where the English moves from "steadfast" to "faithful".

ko.B: 네 집안과 네 나라가 네 앞에서 영원히 든든히 설 것이며, 네 왕좌가 영원히 굳게 설 것이다.'"
