ko.L: 그러자 다윗 왕이 들어가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 앉아서 말했다. "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 제가 누구[이며] 제 집이 무엇[이기에], 주님께서 저를 여기까지 이끌어 오셨습니까?
ko.B: 그러자 다윗 왕이 들어가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 앉아서 말했다. "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 제가 누구이며 제 집안이 무엇이기에, 주님께서 저를 이렇게까지 이끌어 주셨습니까?
ko.R: 그러자 다윗 왕은 장막 안으로 들어가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 앉았다. 그가 말했다. "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 저는 누구입니까? 제 집안은 무엇입니까? 어찌하여 주님께서는 저를 여기까지 이끌어 주셨습니까?

pt.L: E o rei Davi entrou e se sentou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e disse: "Quem [sou] eu, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, e o que [é] a minha casa, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me tenhas trazido até aqui?
pt.B: Então o rei Davi entrou, sentou-se diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e disse: "Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, quem sou eu, e o que é a minha casa, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me tenhas trazido até este ponto?
pt.R: Então o rei Davi entrou na tenda e se sentou diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele disse: "Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, quem sou eu? E o que é a minha família? Por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me trouxeste até aqui?

decisions.choice: sat before Yahweh: in the tent where the ark was kept
decisions.reason: To be "before Yahweh" was to be in his presence at the sanctuary, here the tent David had set up for the ark in Jerusalem (6:17; verse 2). Sitting to pray is unusual; David sits as one at home in Yahweh's presence.

decisions.choice: my Lord Yahweh: the master to whom David belongs
decisions.reason: David joins the title "my Lord", used of a master, to the name Yahweh. The pair comes seven times in this prayer (verses 18, 19 twice, 20, 22, 28, 29), and it answers Yahweh's "my servant David" (verses 5, 8): David speaks as a servant to his master.

decisions.choice: Who am I ...?: I am not worthy of this
decisions.reason: The question is a way of saying how small one is before a great gift or task (1 Samuel 18:18; Exodus 3:11).

decisions.choice: my house: my family
decisions.reason: Here David's house is his family, not the palace. He has just heard that Yahweh will make it a house of kings (verse 11).

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: Where "Lord" stands before the divine name, the name is printed "GOD" so that it is not read "Lord LORD", as in the terms used for these books.

decisions.choice: went into the tent
decisions.reason: Readable says where David went (m1).

decisions.choice: Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}; God addressed as "tu" with the deity pronoun span
decisions.reason: As the Samuel and Pentateuch terms notes set for *Adonai YHWH*: the name is printed "DIEU" after "Seigneur", with "Yahvé" as the setting. God is addressed with "tu", as everywhere in the French; the span covers "tu", "te", "toi", "ton", "ta", "tes".

decisions.choice: Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel, as the Pentateuch and Samuel terms notes set for Adonai YHWH: "Señor DIOS", with the span on "DIOS" alone. David speaks to God with "tú", and the deity pronoun setting goes on the written pronouns (tú, te, ti, tu); none is needed where the pronoun is only in the verb ending.

decisions.choice: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}
decisions.reason: Where "Lord" stands before the divine name, the name is written MUNGU, "Bwana MUNGU", as set for Samuel and in the Pentateuch note, so that it is not read "Bwana BWANA".

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa là CHÚA" for *Adonai YHWH*, with the divine_name span on the second word
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's form for "Lord GOD", as Genesis 15:2; David prays as "con" and speaks to God as "Ngài", as the Genesis note sets.

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" for *Adonai YHWH*, with the span on "하나님"; David prays in the formal polite style (합쇼체), calling God "주님" and himself "저" and "주님의 종"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for "Lord GOD"; the prayer follows the Korean style guide for people speaking to God.

decisions.choice: Senhor DEUS (Senhor Javé), with no article; tu
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 3:24 and 9:26 in Portuguese and the Old Testament terms: Adonai YHWH is "Senhor DEUS", with only the name under the setting, and without the article in the vocative. David prays with "tu" throughout (verses 18-29), every pronoun for God under the deity_pronoun span, as the book-wide rule for prayer in 1 Samuel (1:11).

source.text: וַתִּקְטַן֩ ע֨וֹד זֹ֤את בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַתְּדַבֵּ֛ר גַּ֥ם אֶל־בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְמֵֽרָח֑וֹק וְזֹ֛את תּוֹרַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was small still this in your eyes, my Lord Yahweh, and you have spoken also about [the] house of your servant for from far; and this [is the] law of the man, my Lord Yahweh?

en.L: And yet this was small in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken also of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant's house for a distant [time]. And [is] this the custom of mankind, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}?
en.B: And as if this were too little in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have also spoken about the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant far into the future. Is this the way human beings deal with one another, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}?
en.R: And as if that were not enough, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have also made promises about my family for a long time to come. People do not treat one another like this, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}!

es.L: Y aun esto fue poco a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, y has hablado también de la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo para tiempo lejano. ¿Y es esta la costumbre del hombre, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}?
es.B: Y como si esto fuera poco a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, también has hablado de la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo para un futuro lejano. ¿Es así como se tratan los seres humanos, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}?
es.R: Y como si eso fuera poco, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, también me has hecho promesas sobre mi familia para mucho tiempo por venir. ¡Las personas no se tratan así unas a otras, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}!

fr.L: Et cela était encore peu de chose à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as parlé aussi de la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur pour un [temps] lointain. Et [est]-ce là la loi de l’homme, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ?
fr.B: Et comme si c’était encore trop peu à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as aussi parlé de la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur pour un avenir lointain. Est-ce ainsi que les humains agissent entre eux, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ?
fr.R: Et comme si cela ne suffisait pas, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as aussi fait des promesses pour ma famille, pour un long avenir. Les gens n’agissent pas ainsi les uns envers les autres, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Na bado hili lilikuwa dogo machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, nawe umesema pia juu ya nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa [wakati] wa mbali. Je, hii [ndiyo] desturi ya wanadamu, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}?
sw.B: Na kana kwamba hili lilikuwa dogo machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, umesema pia kuhusu nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa siku nyingi zijazo. Je, hivi ndivyo wanadamu wanavyotendeana, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}?
sw.R: Na kana kwamba hayo hayatoshi, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, umetoa pia ahadi kuhusu jamaa yangu kwa muda mrefu ujao. Watu hawatendeani hivi, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}!

vi.L: Thế mà điều này vẫn còn là nhỏ trong mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn phán về nhà của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho đến thời xa xăm. Đây có phải là lệ thường của loài người không, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?
vi.B: Như thể điều này vẫn còn quá nhỏ trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại còn phán về nhà của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho đến tương lai lâu dài. Loài người có đối đãi với nhau như vậy đâu, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?
vi.R: Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như thể như vậy vẫn chưa đủ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn hứa về gia đình con cho đến muôn đời sau. Loài người không bao giờ đối xử với nhau như thế, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}!

ko.L: 그런데 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 이것도 주님의 눈에는 작은 일이어서, 주님께서 주님의 종의 집에 대해서도 먼 [앞날]까지 말씀하셨습니다. 그리고 이것이 사람의 법도입니까, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}?
ko.B: 그런데 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서는 이것도 작은 일로 여기셔서, 주님의 종의 집안에 대해서도 먼 앞날의 일까지 말씀해 주셨습니다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 사람이 이렇게 대할 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 그것만으로도 크신 은혜인데, 주님께서는 제 집안에 대해서도 먼 앞날까지 약속해 주셨습니다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 사람은 서로 이렇게 대하지 않습니다!

pt.L: E ainda isto foi pouco aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste também da casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo para um [tempo] distante. E [é] este o costume da humanidade, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}?
pt.B: E, como se isso fosse pouco aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste também da casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo para um futuro distante. É assim que os seres humanos tratam uns aos outros, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}?
pt.R: E, como se isso não bastasse, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste também promessas sobre a minha família para muito tempo no futuro. As pessoas não tratam umas às outras assim, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}!

decisions.choice: this was small in your eyes: as if this were not enough for you
decisions.reason: What Yahweh has done for David already is great, yet to Yahweh it was a small thing, and he has added more.

decisions.choice: for a distant time: far into the future
decisions.reason: "From far" can speak of distance in space or time. Here it is the future: Yahweh has spoken of David's house in the generations to come.

decisions.choice: and this is the custom of humankind?: no person deals this way
alternatives: and this is instruction for humankind
may this be the rule for the people
decisions.reason: The words, literally "and this is the law (or instruction) of the man", are hard to understand. The translation takes them as a question of wonder: people do not treat one another with such generosity, yet Yahweh has treated David this way. Others read them as "this is instruction for humankind", a word about David's line that reaches all people, or as a wish, "may this be the rule for the people". The parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:17 has different words: "you have regarded me as a man of high rank".

decisions.choice: your servant: David himself
decisions.reason: Calling oneself "your servant" is a polite and humble way of saying "I" when speaking to a superior (1 Samuel 17:32). David uses it ten times in this prayer.

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: As in verse 18.

decisions.choice: your servant (Literal, Balanced); I, me (Readable)
decisions.reason: Calling oneself "your servant" is the polite form of address, which has "your servant" at every level in these books (1 Samuel 23:10-11), Literal included. David's prayer speaks of himself as "your servant" again and again, and Readable often says "I" or "me" instead, since the phrase is a polite way of saying "I" (verse 19).

decisions.choice: People do not treat one another like this!
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies (m3).

decisions.choice: "tu siervo" (L, B); "me", "mi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels and the Samuel terms note: David calls himself "tu siervo" before God at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "me" and "mi", as the English says "I" and "me".

decisions.choice: mtumishi wako (Literal, Balanced); mimi, -angu (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Your servant" in speech to God or the king is "mtumishi wako" at every level, as set for Samuel in Swahili; where the English Readable says "I" or "me" for it, Readable does the same.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ngài" (L, B); "con" (R) for "your servant" in prayer
decisions.reason: David's polite self-reference before God follows the English: "your servant" at Literal and Balanced, "I" at Readable where the English Readable has it, with "Ngài" in a deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "주님의 종" for "your servant" at Literal and Balanced; "제" (my) at Readable here, "주님의 종" where the English Readable keeps the words
decisions.reason: David's polite self-reference before God; Readable follows the English Readable in each verse.

decisions.choice: o teu servo (L, B)
decisions.reason: David names himself to God in the courtly third person (m4), and since he speaks to God with "tu" it is "o teu servo", as Moses says "o teu servo" in Deuteronomy 3:24 in Portuguese; Readable says "eu", "mim", "minha família", as the English Readable does, keeping "o teu servo" where the English Readable keeps it.

source.text: וּמַה־יּוֹסִ֥יף דָּוִ֛ד ע֖וֹד לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְאַתָּ֛ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And what will add David again to speak to you? And you, you know your servant, my Lord Yahweh.

en.L: And what more can David say to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}.
en.B: What more can David say to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? You know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}.
en.R: What more can I say to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}? You know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}.

es.L: ¿Y qué más puede decirte David? Pues {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¿Qué más puede decirte David? Tú conoces a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¿Qué más puedo decirte? Tú conoces a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et que pourrait David {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire de plus ? Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Que pourrait David {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire de plus ? Tu connais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Que puis-je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dire de plus ? Tu connais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Daudi aweza kukuambia nini zaidi? Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unamjua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Daudi aweza kukuambia nini zaidi? Wewe unamjua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Niseme nini zaidi kwako? Wewe unamjua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Đa-vít còn có thể nói gì thêm với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nữa? Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đa-vít còn có thể nói gì thêm với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ngài biết rõ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Con còn có thể nói gì thêm với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ngài biết rõ đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 주님께 다시 무슨 말을 더 하겠습니까? 주님께서는 주님의 종을 아십니다, 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}.
ko.B: 다윗이 주님께 무슨 말씀을 더 드릴 수 있겠습니까? 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서는 주님의 종을 아십니다.
ko.R: 제가 주님께 무슨 말씀을 더 드리겠습니까? 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서는 주님의 종을 잘 아십니다.

pt.L: E que mais Davi poderá ainda {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dizer? Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conheces o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.B: Que mais Davi pode {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dizer? Tu conheces o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.R: Que mais eu posso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dizer? Tu conheces o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: What more can David say?: David speaks of himself by name
decisions.reason: David names himself, as a servant might before his master. The question means he has nothing to add: Yahweh's gift goes beyond words.

decisions.choice: you know your servant: you know me through and through
decisions.reason: To know a person can mean more than to be aware of him: to know him closely and to have chosen him (Genesis 18:19; Amos 3:2). David has no need to tell Yahweh who he is.

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: As in verse 18.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: I
decisions.reason: Readable says "I" for David's name, which in English would sound as if someone else were meant.

source.text: בַּעֲב֤וּר דְּבָֽרְךָ֙ וּֽכְלִבְּךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַגְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את לְהוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת־עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For the sake of your word and according to your heart you have done all the greatness the this, to make known [to] your servant.

en.L: For the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word and according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} heart {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done all this greatness, to make [it] known to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: For the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word and as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own heart chose, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done this great thing and made it known to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.R: You have done this great thing because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise and because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wanted to. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have told me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, about it.

es.L: Por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra y conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} corazón has hecho toda esta grandeza, para dar[la] a conocer a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.B: Por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra y según lo quiso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propio corazón, has hecho esta gran obra y se la has dado a conocer a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.R: Has hecho esta gran obra por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa y porque así lo quisiste. Y me lo has contado a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.

fr.L: À cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole et selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} cœur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait toute cette grande chose, pour [la] faire connaître à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.B: À cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole et selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propre cœur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as accompli cette grande œuvre et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as fait connaître à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.R: Tu as fait cette grande chose à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse et parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le voulais. Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me l’as fait connaître, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na kwa kadiri ya moyo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} umefanya ukuu huu wote, ili kumjulisha mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Kwa ajili ya neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na kama moyo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ulivyochagua, umefanya jambo hili kuu na kumjulisha mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Umefanya jambo hili kuu kwa sababu ya ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kwa sababu ulitaka hivyo. Nawe umeniambia mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, habari zake.

vi.L: Vì cớ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và theo lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm mọi điều lớn lao này, để cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết.
vi.B: Vì cớ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa và theo ý muốn của lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm việc lớn lao này và cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biết.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm việc lớn lao này vì lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn làm. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, biết điều đó.

ko.L: 주님께서는 주님의 말씀 때문에, 그리고 주님의 마음대로 이 모든 큰일을 행하셔서, 주님의 종에게 알게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 주님의 말씀을 이루시려고, 주님의 뜻대로 이 큰일을 행하시고 그것을 주님의 종에게 알려 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 약속하셨기 때문에, 그리고 그렇게 하기를 원하셨기 때문에 이 큰일을 하셨습니다. 그리고 그 일을 주님의 종인 저에게 알려 주셨습니다.

pt.L: Por causa da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra e segundo o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} coração, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste toda esta grandeza, para [a] dar a conhecer ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.B: Por causa da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra e como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} próprio coração quis, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste esta grande coisa e a deste a conhecer ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.R: Tu fizeste esta grande coisa por causa da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa e porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} quiseste. E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me contaste isso, a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.

decisions.choice: for the sake of your word: because you had promised
decisions.reason: Yahweh's word is the promise he had already given, from David's anointing on (1 Samuel 16:1, 12-13), and now spoken fully through Nathan. The parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:19 has "for the sake of your servant".

decisions.choice: according to your heart: as you yourself chose
decisions.reason: What Yahweh has done comes from his own will, not from anything David earned (compare 1 Samuel 13:14).

decisions.choice: this greatness: this great deed
decisions.reason: The word means greatness, and here a great thing done: the promise of a lasting house.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: your promise
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word was, a promise (m1).

source.text: עַל־כֵּ֥ן גָּדַ֖לְתָּ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כִּֽי־אֵ֣ין כָּמ֗וֹךָ וְאֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ זֽוּלָתֶ֔ךָ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּאָזְנֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore you are great, my Lord Yahweh, for there is none like you, and there is no God except you, in all that we have heard with our ears.

en.L: Therefore {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are great, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, for there is none like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and there is no God besides {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
en.B: That is why {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are great, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}. There is no one like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and there is no God but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, as all we have heard with our own ears tells us.
en.R: So {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are great, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}! No one is like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. There is no God except {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Everything we have ever heard tells us so.

es.L: Por tanto, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres grande, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, porque no hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y no hay Dios fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, conforme a todo lo que hemos oído con nuestros oídos.
es.B: Por eso {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres grande, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}. No hay nadie como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y no hay Dios aparte de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, como nos lo dice todo lo que hemos oído con nuestros propios oídos.
es.R: ¡Por eso {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres grande, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}! Nadie es como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. No hay Dios fuera de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Todo lo que hemos oído nos lo dice.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, car il n’y a personne comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et il n’y a pas de Dieu en dehors de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, d’après tout ce que nous avons entendu de nos oreilles.
fr.B: Voilà pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}. Nul n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} : tout ce que nous avons entendu de nos propres oreilles nous le dit.
fr.R: Oui, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} ! Personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Il n’y a pas d’autre Dieu que {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Tout ce que nous avons entendu nous le dit.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} u mkuu, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, kwa maana hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, wala hakuna Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, kwa kadiri ya yote tuliyosikia kwa masikio yetu.
sw.B: Ndiyo maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} u mkuu, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}. Hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, wala hakuna Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, kama yote tuliyosikia kwa masikio yetu wenyewe yanavyotuambia.
sw.R: Basi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} u mkuu, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}! Hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Hakuna Mungu ila {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Kila kitu tulichowahi kusikia kinatuambia hivyo.

vi.L: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, theo mọi điều chúng con đã nghe tận tai.
vi.B: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đúng như mọi điều chúng con đã nghe tận tai.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật vĩ đại, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Không ai giống như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Không có Đức Chúa Trời nào ngoài {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mọi điều chúng con từng nghe đều cho thấy như vậy.

ko.L: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님은 위대하십니다. 우리가 우리 귀로 들은 모든 것대로, 주님 같은 이가 없고, 주님 외에는 하나님이 없습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님은 위대하십니다. 우리가 우리 귀로 들은 모든 것이 말해 주듯이, 주님 같은 분은 없고 주님 말고는 하나님이 없습니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님은 위대하십니다! 주님 같은 분은 아무도 없습니다. 주님 말고는 하나님이 없습니다. 우리가 지금까지 들은 모든 것이 그렇게 말해 줍니다.

pt.L: Por isso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és grande, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, pois não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, e não há Deus além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, segundo tudo o que ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos.
pt.B: É por isso que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és grande, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}. Não há ninguém como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, e não há Deus além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, como nos diz tudo o que ouvimos com os nossos próprios ouvidos.
pt.R: Por isso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és grande, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}! Ninguém é como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}. Não existe Deus além de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Tudo o que já ouvimos nos diz isso.

decisions.choice: therefore: praise that follows from what Yahweh has done
decisions.reason: David turns from Yahweh's gift to Yahweh himself: because of what he has done, he is great.

decisions.choice: there is none like you, and no God except you
decisions.reason: David uses the words of Israel's basic confession (Deuteronomy 4:35, 39) and of Hannah's prayer (1 Samuel 2:2).

decisions.choice: all that we have heard with our ears: what has been told from generation to generation
decisions.reason: Israel knew Yahweh's deeds from what parents told their children (Psalm 44:2; Judges 6:13).

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: As in verse 18.

decisions.choice: não há Deus além de ti
alternatives: não há Deus fora de ti
decisions.reason: "Além de ti" keeps the words of Hannah's song in 1 Samuel 2:2 in Portuguese ("não há outro além de ti"), which m2 points to.

source.text: וּמִ֤י כְעַמְּךָ֙ כְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלְכֽוּ־אֱ֠לֹהִים לִפְדּֽוֹת־ל֨וֹ לְעָ֜ם וְלָשׂ֧וּם ל֣וֹ שֵׁ֗ם וְלַעֲשׂ֨וֹת לָכֶ֜ם הַגְּדוּלָּ֤ה וְנֹֽרָאוֹת֙ לְאַרְצֶ֔ךָ מִפְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּדִ֤יתָ לְּךָ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם גּוֹיִ֖ם וֵאלֹהָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And who [is] like your people, like Israel, one nation on the earth, whom went God to redeem for himself as a people, and to set for himself a name, and to do for you the greatness and awesome [things] for your land, from before your people whom you redeemed for yourself from Egypt, nations and its gods?

en.L: And who [is] like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, like Israel, one nation on the earth, whom God went to redeem for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} as a people, and to make a name for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, and to do for you great and awesome [things] for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land, before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} redeemed for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} from Egypt, [driving out] nations and their gods?
en.B: Who is there like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel, the one nation on earth that God went to redeem as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people? He made a name for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} and did great and awesome things for them and for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land, driving out nations and their gods before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} redeemed for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} from Egypt.
en.R: There is no nation on earth like {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel! God went to set them free so that they would be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people. That made {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name famous. You did great and amazing things for them and for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land. You drove out other nations and their gods to make room for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set free from Egypt to be {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own.

es.L: ¿Y quién [es] como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, como Israel, una nación en la tierra, a la que Dios fue a redimir para {{deity_pronoun:sí|Sí}} como pueblo, y a ponerse un nombre, y a hacer por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} grandezas y [cosas] temibles por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierra, delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} redimiste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} de Egipto, [expulsando] naciones y a sus dioses?
es.B: ¿Quién hay como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel, la única nación de la tierra que Dios fue a redimir como pueblo {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}}? Se hizo un nombre e hizo por ellos grandes y temibles cosas, y por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierra, expulsando naciones y a sus dioses delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, al que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} redimiste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} de Egipto.
es.R: ¡No hay en la tierra otra nación como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel! Dios fue a liberarlos para que fueran {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo. Así hizo famoso {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Hiciste cosas grandes y asombrosas por ellos y por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierra. Expulsaste a otras naciones y a sus dioses para hacerle lugar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, al que liberaste de Egipto para que fuera {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}}.

fr.L: Et qui [est] comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, comme Israël, nation unique sur la terre, que Dieu est allé racheter pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} comme peuple, et pour se faire un nom, et pour faire pour vous des [choses] grandes et redoutables pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays, devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as racheté pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} d’Égypte, [en chassant] des nations et leurs dieux ?
fr.B: Qui est comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, la seule nation sur la terre que Dieu soit allé racheter pour en faire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ? Il s’est fait un nom et il a accompli pour eux et pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays des choses grandes et redoutables, en chassant des nations et leurs dieux devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as racheté pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} d’Égypte.
fr.R: Aucune nation sur la terre n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël ! Dieu est allé le libérer pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Ainsi, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom est devenu célèbre. Tu as fait pour eux et pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays des choses grandes et extraordinaires. Tu as chassé d’autres nations et leurs dieux pour faire de la place à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as libéré d’Égypte pour qu’il soit à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Na ni nani [aliye] kama watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama Israeli, taifa moja duniani, ambalo Mungu alikwenda kulikomboa kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe kuwa watu, na kujifanyia jina, na kuwatendea ninyi mambo makuu na ya kutisha kwa ajili ya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uliowakomboa kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kutoka Misri, [ukifukuza] mataifa na miungu yao?
sw.B: Ni nani aliye kama watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli, taifa pekee duniani ambalo Mungu alikwenda kulikomboa liwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe? Alijifanyia jina, akawatendea mambo makuu na ya kutisha wao na nchi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, ukiyafukuza mataifa na miungu yao mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uliowakomboa kutoka Misri wawe {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Hakuna taifa duniani lililo kama watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli! Mungu alikwenda kuwaweka huru ili wawe watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. Jambo hilo lililifanya jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kuwa maarufu. Uliwatendea wao na nchi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mambo makuu na ya ajabu. Uliyafukuza mataifa mengine na miungu yao ili kuwapa nafasi watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uliowaweka huru kutoka Misri wawe {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

vi.L: Có dân nào giống như dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như Y-sơ-ra-ên, một dân tộc trên đất mà Đức Chúa Trời đã đi chuộc về làm dân cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một danh, và để làm cho các ngươi những việc lớn lao và đáng sợ cho xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trước mặt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chuộc về cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ Ai Cập, [đuổi] các dân tộc và các thần của họ?
vi.B: Có dân nào giống như Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân tộc duy nhất trên đất mà Đức Chúa Trời đã đi chuộc về làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}? Ngài đã làm cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được biết đến và làm những việc lớn lao, đáng sợ cho họ và cho xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đuổi các dân tộc và các thần của họ khỏi trước mặt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chuộc về cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} từ Ai Cập.
vi.R: Không có dân tộc nào trên đất giống như Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Đức Chúa Trời đã đi giải phóng họ để họ làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhờ đó danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được lừng lẫy. Ngài đã làm những việc lớn lao và kỳ diệu cho họ và cho xứ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã đuổi các dân tộc khác cùng các thần của họ đi để nhường chỗ cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải phóng khỏi Ai Cập để thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 땅 위에 있는 한 민족, 주님의 백성 이스라엘 같은 [민족이] 누구[입니까]? 하나님께서 가셔서 그들을 그분의 백성으로 구속하시고, 그분의 이름을 내시고, 너희를 위하여 큰일과 두려운 일들을 행하시고, 주님의 땅을 위하여 주님께서 이집트에서 주님을 위하여 구속하신 주님의 백성 앞에서 민족들과 그들의 신들을 [쫓아내셨습니다].
ko.B: 땅 위에 주님의 백성 이스라엘 같은 민족이 또 어디 있겠습니까? 하나님께서 친히 가셔서 그들을 구속하여 그분의 백성으로 삼으셨습니다. 그분은 이름을 떨치셨고, 그들을 위하여, 또 주님의 땅을 위하여 크고 두려운 일들을 행하셨습니다. 주님께서는 이집트에서 구속하여 주님의 것으로 삼으신 주님의 백성 앞에서 민족들과 그들의 신들을 쫓아내셨습니다.
ko.R: 땅 위에 주님의 백성 이스라엘 같은 민족은 없습니다! 하나님께서 가셔서 그들을 자유롭게 하시고 그분의 백성으로 삼으셨습니다. 그 일로 그분의 이름이 널리 알려졌습니다. 주님께서는 그들을 위해, 또 주님의 땅을 위해 크고 놀라운 일들을 하셨습니다. 주님께서 이집트에서 자유롭게 하여 주님의 것으로 삼으신 백성을 위해, 다른 민족들과 그들의 신들을 쫓아내셨습니다.

pt.L: E quem [é] como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, como Israel, uma nação na terra, a quem Deus foi resgatar para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} como povo, e para fazer para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} um nome, e para fazer por vocês grandes e temíveis [coisas] pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} terra, diante do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resgataste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} do Egito, [expulsando] nações e os seus deuses?
pt.B: Quem há como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel, a única nação na terra que Deus foi resgatar para ser o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo? Ele fez para {{deity_pronoun:si|Si}} um nome e realizou coisas grandes e temíveis por eles e pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} terra, expulsando nações e os seus deuses de diante do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} resgataste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} do Egito.
pt.R: Não há nenhuma nação na terra como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel! Deus foi libertá-lo para que fosse o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio povo. Isso tornou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome famoso. Tu fizeste coisas grandes e maravilhosas por eles e pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} terra. Tu expulsaste outras nações e os seus deuses para abrir lugar para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} libertaste do Egito para ser só {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}}.

decisions.choice: who is like your people ...?: Israel's unique story
decisions.reason: David echoes Moses: no other god ever went to take a nation for himself out of another nation, with signs and wonders, as Yahweh did for Israel in Egypt (Deuteronomy 4:7, 32-34; 33:29).

decisions.choice: redeem: set free from slavery
decisions.reason: The verb means to free someone by paying a price. It is used of Yahweh rescuing Israel from slavery in Egypt (Deuteronomy 7:8; 9:26).

decisions.choice: God went: Israel's God, with a plural verb
decisions.reason: The verb is plural, which could also be read "gods went". But the words "for himself" and the whole verse show that Israel's God is meant; the parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:21 has the singular.

decisions.choice: for them, for your land, driving out nations and their gods
alternatives: to do great things for you (Israel)
nations and its gods (as the Hebrew stands)
decisions.reason: The end of the verse is hard to read as it stands. It says "to do for you (plural) greatness and awesome things for your land, from before your people ... nations and its gods". The parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:21 reads "by driving out nations from before your people", and the translation follows that sense, taking "for you" as Israel and "its gods" as the gods of the nations. The old Greek translation has "to drive out nations and tents".

decisions.choice: [driving out]
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the verb the sentence lacks, from the parallel in 1 Chronicles 17:21 (m4).

decisions.choice: for them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "for them" for the plural "for you" that suddenly addresses Israel, and break the long question into shorter sentences.

decisions.choice: "por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns here to a plural "you" (Israel); Literal keeps it, so Spanish takes the plural-you span. Balanced and Readable say "por ellos", as the English says "for them".

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (L) for the Hebrew "for you" (plural)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's sudden "you" as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "them" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Literal keeps the Hebrew's sudden "너희를 위하여" (for you, plural) and its turns between "하나님께서 ... 그분의" and "주님"; Balanced and Readable say "그들을 위하여" with the meaning decision
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's shifts of person are kept at Literal so a reader can see the textual difficulty the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: resgatar (L, B), libertar (R); por vocês (L), por eles (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Resgatar" at Literal and Balanced and "libertar" at Readable, as Deuteronomy 9:26 in Portuguese for the same verb (m2). Literal keeps the sudden plural "you" of the Hebrew (m4) with "vocês", the living plural; Balanced and Readable say "por eles", as the English says "for them".

source.text: וַתְּכ֣וֹנֵֽן לְ֠ךָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ֨יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀לְךָ֛ לְעָ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And you established for yourself your people Israel for you as a people until forever, and you, Yahweh, have become for them as God.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} established for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel to be a people for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have become their God.
en.B: You established {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own people forever, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, have become their God.
en.R: You made Israel {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own people forever. And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, became their God.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} estableciste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel para que fuera pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}} para siempre, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, has llegado a ser su Dios.
es.B: Estableciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel como pueblo {{deity_pronoun:tuyo|Tuyo}} para siempre, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, has llegado a ser su Dios.
es.R: Hiciste de Israel {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} propio pueblo para siempre. Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, llegaste a ser su Dios.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as affermi pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple pour toujours, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es devenu leur Dieu.
fr.B: Tu as établi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple pour toujours, et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es devenu leur Dieu.
fr.R: Tu as fait d’Israël {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple pour toujours. Et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es devenu leur Dieu.

sw.L: Nawe umejiimarishia watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} milele, nawe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umekuwa Mungu wao.
sw.B: Umewaimarisha watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mwenyewe milele, nawe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umekuwa Mungu wao.
sw.R: Umewafanya Israeli kuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} milele. Nawe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukawa Mungu wao.

vi.L: Ngài đã lập dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã trở nên Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.B: Ngài đã lập dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã trở nên Đức Chúa Trời của họ.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên thành dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã trở nên Đức Chúa Trời của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 주님께서는 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 주님을 위하여 영원히 주님의 백성으로 굳게 세우셨고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그들의 하나님이 되셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 주님의 백성 이스라엘을 영원히 주님의 백성으로 굳게 세우셨고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그들의 하나님이 되셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 이스라엘을 영원히 주님의 백성으로 삼으셨습니다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 그들의 하나님이 되셨습니다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estabeleceste para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel para ser {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo para sempre, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tornaste o Deus deles.
pt.B: Tu firmaste o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo Israel como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} próprio povo para sempre, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tornaste o Deus deles.
pt.R: Tu fizeste de Israel o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo para sempre. E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tornaste o Deus deles.

decisions.choice: your people ... you have become their God: the covenant
decisions.reason: This is the covenant promise: "I will take you as my people, and I will be your God" (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12; Deuteronomy 29:12).

decisions.choice: you established: made firm
decisions.reason: It is the same verb used for David's kingdom and throne (verses 12, 13, 16) and his house (verse 26). Yahweh has made both Israel and David's line firm.

decisions.choice: LORD (when David speaks to him)
decisions.reason: When the divine name is used to address Yahweh it is printed "LORD" without "the".

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} without the article when God is addressed
decisions.reason: As the published French Psalms do: in direct address the name stands without "le", as the English "LORD" stands without "the".

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} (in address, without the article)
decisions.reason: When the divine name is used to speak to God, the span has no article ("SEÑOR"), as the published Spanish Genesis 24:12 does; the English likewise prints "LORD" without "the".

decisions.choice: The vocative "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여" where David speaks to God by name
decisions.reason: Korean prayer marks a name of God used in address with -여, as the published Psalms do ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여").

decisions.choice: estabeleceste (L), firmaste (B); SENHOR without the article in the vocative
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of David's kingdom and throne (m2), so Literal and Balanced keep their wording for it from verses 12-16. In the vocative the name has no article ("SENHOR" / "Javé"), as the book-wide rule of 1 Samuel 1:11 in Portuguese.

source.text: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַל־בֵּית֔וֹ הָקֵ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken about your servant and about his house, confirm until forever, and do as you have spoken.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, the word that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken concerning {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and concerning his house, confirm [it] forever, and do as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.
en.B: And now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, the word {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and about his house, make it stand forever, and do as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have said.
en.R: So now, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, please keep forever the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made about me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, and about my family. Do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said.

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, la palabra que has hablado acerca de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y acerca de su casa, confírma[la] para siempre, y haz como has dicho.
es.B: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, la palabra que has dicho acerca de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y de su casa, hazla firme para siempre, y haz como has dicho.
es.R: Así que ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, te ruego que cumplas para siempre la promesa que me hiciste a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, y a mi familia. Haz lo que dijiste.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, la parole que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcée au sujet de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et au sujet de sa maison, confirme[-la] pour toujours, et fais comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as parlé.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, la parole que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dite au sujet de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et de sa maison, fais-la tenir pour toujours, et agis comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as dit.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, tiens pour toujours la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite pour moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, et pour ma famille. Fais ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit.

sw.L: Na sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, neno ulilosema kuhusu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kuhusu nyumba yake, lithibitishe milele, ukafanye kama ulivyosema.
sw.B: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, neno ulilosema kuhusu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na kuhusu nyumba yake, lisimamishe milele, ukafanye kama ulivyosema.
sw.R: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, tafadhali itimize milele ahadi uliyotoa kuhusu mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, na kuhusu jamaa yangu. Fanya kama ulivyosema.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và về nhà người, xin làm cho [lời ấy] được vững lập đời đời, và xin làm như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và về nhà người được đứng vững đời đời, và xin làm như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin giữ mãi mãi lời hứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và về gia đình con. Xin làm như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종과 그의 집에 대하여 하신 말씀을 영원히 굳게 세우시고, 말씀하신 대로 행하십시오.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님의 종과 그의 집안에 대하여 하신 말씀을 영원히 이루어 주시고, 말씀하신 대로 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님의 종인 저와 제 집안에 대해 하신 약속을 영원히 지켜 주십시오. 말씀하신 대로 해 주십시오.

pt.L: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, a palavra que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste a respeito do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e a respeito da sua casa, confirma-a para sempre, e faze como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste.
pt.B: E agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, a palavra que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste sobre o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo e sobre a casa dele, faze que ela permaneça para sempre, e faze como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste.
pt.R: Agora, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} Deus, por favor, cumpre para sempre a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste sobre mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, e sobre a minha família. Faze o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste.

decisions.choice: confirm: make it stand
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something stand, and so to carry out a promise (1 Samuel 1:23; 1 Kings 2:4).

decisions.choice: do as you have spoken: prayer that holds Yahweh to his promise
decisions.reason: David asks only for what Yahweh has already promised. His prayer rests on Yahweh's word, not on his own wishes.

decisions.choice: the promise
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word here is: a promise.

decisions.choice: LORD God
decisions.reason: When the name is used to address Yahweh it is printed "LORD" without "the" (verse 24).

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

source.text: וְיִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְךָ֤ עַד־עוֹלָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבֵית֙ עַבְדְּךָ֣ דָוִ֔ד יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And may be great your name until forever, saying, Yahweh of hosts [is] God over Israel; and [the] house of your servant David will be established before you.

en.L: And may {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name be great forever, saying, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] God over Israel'; and the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David will be established before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will be great forever, and people will say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is God over Israel!' And {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David's house will stand firm before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Then people will honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever. They will say, '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is the God of Israel!' And my family, the family of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David, will stand firm in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.

es.L: Y sea engrandecido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre para siempre, diciendo: ‘{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] Dios sobre Israel’; y la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David será establecida delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Así {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre será grande para siempre, y la gente dirá: ‘¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es Dios sobre Israel!’. Y la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David permanecerá firme delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Así la gente honrará {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre para siempre. Dirán: ‘¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es el Dios de Israel!’. Y mi familia, la familia de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David, permanecerá firme en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia.

fr.L: Et que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom soit grand pour toujours, et qu’on dise : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] Dieu sur Israël” ; et la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David sera affermie devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom sera grand pour toujours, et l’on dira : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est Dieu sur Israël !” Et la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David sera ferme devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Alors les gens honoreront {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom pour toujours. Ils diront : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est le Dieu d’Israël !” Et ma famille, la famille de David, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, restera solide devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na liwe kuu milele, kusema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ni] Mungu juu ya Israeli'; na nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi itaimarishwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Ndipo jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} litakapokuwa kuu milele, na watu watasema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ni Mungu juu ya Israeli!' Nayo nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi itasimama imara mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ndipo watu watakapoliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} milele. Watasema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ni Mungu wa Israeli!' Nayo jamaa yangu, jamaa ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi, itasimama imara mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

vi.L: Nguyện danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được tôn đại đời đời, để người ta nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân [là] Đức Chúa Trời trên Y-sơ-ra-ên'; và nhà Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ được vững lập trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ được tôn cao đời đời, và người ta sẽ nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân là Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên!' Và nhà Đa-vít, đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ đứng vững trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ người ta sẽ tôn kính danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đời đời. Họ sẽ nói: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân là Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên!' Và gia đình con, là gia đình Đa-vít đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ đứng vững trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 이름이 영원히 크게 되어 '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 이스라엘 위에 계신 하나님[이시다]' 하고 말하게 되기를 [원합니다]. 그리고 주님의 종 다윗의 집이 주님 앞에서 굳게 세워질 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러면 주님의 이름이 영원히 높아지고, 사람들이 '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 이스라엘의 하나님이시다!' 하고 말할 것입니다. 그리고 주님의 종 다윗의 집안이 주님 앞에서 든든히 설 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러면 사람들이 영원히 주님의 이름을 높일 것입니다. 그들이 '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 이스라엘의 하나님이시다!' 하고 말할 것입니다. 그리고 주님의 종 다윗의 집안, 곧 제 집안이 주님 앞에서 든든히 설 것입니다.

pt.L: E seja grande o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para sempre, dizendo-se: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos [é] Deus sobre Israel'; e a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo Davi será estabelecida diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Então o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome será grande para sempre, e o povo dirá: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é Deus sobre Israel!' E a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo Davi ficará firme diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Então as pessoas vão honrar o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome para sempre. Elas vão dizer: '{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é o Deus de Israel!' E a minha família, a família do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo Davi, ficará firme na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença.

decisions.choice: may your name be great: a wish, with its result
decisions.reason: The verb expresses a wish, "may your name be great", and also the result of verse 25: when Yahweh keeps his word, his name will be honored.

decisions.choice: established: made firm
decisions.reason: The same word as in verse 16. David's house stands firm "before" Yahweh, in his presence and under his care.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts (Literal); the LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 8.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

source.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּלִ֜יתָה אֶת־אֹ֤זֶן עַבְדְּךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בַּ֖יִת אֶבְנֶה־לָּ֑ךְ עַל־כֵּ֗ן מָצָ֤א עַבְדְּךָ֙ אֶת־לִבּ֔וֹ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלֶ֔יךָ אֶת־הַתְּפִלָּ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: For you, Yahweh of hosts, God of Israel, have uncovered the ear of your servant, saying, A house I will build for you; therefore has found your servant his heart to pray to you the prayer the this.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, God of Israel, have uncovered the ear of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, saying, 'I will build a house for you.' Therefore {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant has found his heart to pray this prayer to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed this to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant: 'I will build a house for you.' That is why {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant has found the courage to pray this prayer to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, God of Israel, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have told me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, 'I will build a house for you, a family of kings.' That is why I have been bold enough to pray this prayer to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, Dios de Israel, has descubierto el oído de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, diciendo: ‘Yo te edificaré una casa’. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo ha hallado su corazón para hacerte esta oración.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, Dios de Israel, le has revelado esto a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo: ‘Yo te edificaré una casa’. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo se ha atrevido a hacerte esta oración.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, Dios de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me has dicho a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo: ‘Yo te edificaré una casa, una familia de reyes’. Por eso me he atrevido a hacerte esta oración.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, Dieu d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as découvert l’oreille de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, en disant : “Je te bâtirai une maison.” C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur a trouvé son cœur pour {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adresser cette prière.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, Dieu d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait cette révélation à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur : “Je te bâtirai une maison.” Voilà pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur a trouvé le courage de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adresser cette prière.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, Dieu d’Israël, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as dit, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur : “Je te bâtirai une maison, une famille de rois.” C’est pourquoi j’ai osé {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adresser cette prière.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, umelifunua sikio la mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ukisema, 'Nitakujengea nyumba.' Kwa hiyo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ameuona moyo wake kukuomba maombi haya.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, umemfunulia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} jambo hili: 'Nitakujengea nyumba.' Ndiyo sababu mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} amepata ujasiri wa kukuomba maombi haya.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, umeniambia mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, 'Nitakujengea nyumba, yaani ukoo wa wafalme.' Ndiyo sababu nimepata ujasiri wa kukuomba maombi haya.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã mở tai đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà phán: 'Ta sẽ xây cho ngươi một nhà.' Vì thế đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới dám dâng lời cầu nguyện này lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã tỏ cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết: 'Ta sẽ xây cho con một nhà.' Vì thế đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới đủ can đảm dâng lời cầu nguyện này lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Ta sẽ xây cho con một nhà, tức là một dòng dõi các vua.' Vì thế con mới dám dâng lời cầu nguyện này lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종의 귀를 여시고 '내가 너를 위하여 집을 세우겠다' 하고 말씀하셨기 때문에, 주님의 종이 주님께 이 기도를 드릴 마음을 얻었습니다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님, 주님께서 주님의 종에게 '내가 너를 위하여 한 집안을 세우겠다' 하고 알려 주셨습니다. 그래서 주님의 종이 용기를 내어 주님께 이 기도를 드립니다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님, 주님께서는 주님의 종인 저에게 '내가 너를 위해 한 집안을 세우겠다. 왕들이 네 뒤를 이을 것이다' 하고 말씀해 주셨습니다. 그래서 제가 용기를 내어 주님께 이 기도를 드립니다.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, descobriste o ouvido do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, dizendo: 'Eu te edificarei uma casa.' Por isso o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo achou o seu coração para orar a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} esta oração.
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, revelaste isto ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo: 'Eu te construirei uma casa.' É por isso que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo encontrou coragem para {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fazer esta oração.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me disseste, a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo: 'Eu vou construir uma casa para ti, uma família de reis.' Por isso tive coragem de {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fazer esta oração.

decisions.choice: uncovered the ear: revealed
decisions.reason: To uncover someone's ear is to tell him something he did not know (1 Samuel 9:15; 20:2).

decisions.choice: I will build a house for you: the reversal of verse 5
decisions.reason: David wanted to build a house for Yahweh (verse 5); Yahweh builds one for David. David uses the word "build" for what Yahweh called making him a house (verse 11).

decisions.choice: found his heart: found courage
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of will and courage (1 Samuel 17:32). Yahweh's promise has given David the boldness to ask.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: LORD of hosts (Literal); LORD of Armies (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 8, addressed to Yahweh without "the" (verse 24).

decisions.choice: a house, a family of kings
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, Readable adds what the house is.

decisions.choice: "đã mở tai đầy tớ Ngài" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of uncovering the ear; Balanced and Readable say "revealed" (meaning decision). God's words inside the quotation call David "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable, as he speaks to his servant (5:2).

decisions.choice: Eu te edificarei (L) / construirei (B, R) uma casa
decisions.reason: David says "build" for what God called "making" him a house in verse 11 (m2), so Portuguese uses the verb of verses 5 and 13 ("edificar" at Literal, "construir" at Balanced and Readable), and the reversal can be heard. The "te" in God's words is David, so it has no deity_pronoun span.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּה־הוּא֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּדְבָרֶ֖יךָ יִהְי֣וּ אֱמֶ֑ת וַתְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶֽל־עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶת־הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, my Lord Yahweh, you, he [is] the God, and your words are truth, and you have spoken to your servant the good [thing] the this.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are God, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words are truth, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken this good [thing] to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: And now, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are God, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words are true, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have promised this good thing to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone are God, and what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say can be trusted. You have promised this good thing to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.

es.L: Y ahora, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras son verdad, y has hablado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo este bien.
es.B: Y ahora, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios, y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras son verdaderas, y le has prometido este bien a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.R: Ahora, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres Dios, y se puede confiar en lo que dices. Me has prometido este bien a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.

fr.L: Et maintenant, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui es Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles sont vérité, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ce bien.
fr.B: Maintenant, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui es Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles sont vraies, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as promis ce bonheur à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.R: Maintenant, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es Dieu, et on peut avoir confiance en ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dis. Tu m’as promis ce bonheur, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Na sasa, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu, na maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ni kweli, nawe umemwambia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [jambo] hili jema.
sw.B: Na sasa, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu, na maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ni kweli, nawe umemwahidi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} jambo hili jema.
sw.R: Sasa, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} peke yako ndiwe Mungu, na unachosema kinaaminika. Umeniahidi mimi, mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, jambo hili jema.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, các lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là chân thật, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán điều tốt lành này với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là chân thật, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa điều tốt lành này với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bây giờ, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, và lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán là đáng tin cậy. Ngài đã hứa điều tốt lành này với con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님, 주님은 하나님이시고, 주님의 말씀은 진리이며, 주님께서 주님의 종에게 이 좋은 [것을] 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.B: 이제 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님은 하나님이십니다. 주님의 말씀은 참되시며, 주님께서 주님의 종에게 이 좋은 일을 약속하셨습니다.
ko.R: 이제 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님만이 하나님이십니다. 주님의 말씀은 믿을 수 있습니다. 주님께서 주님의 종인 저에게 이 좋은 일을 약속하셨습니다.

pt.L: E agora, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus, e as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras são verdade, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} falaste ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo esta [coisa] boa.
pt.B: E agora, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus, as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras são verdadeiras, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prometeste esta coisa boa ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.R: Agora, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, só {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és Deus, e o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dizes é digno de confiança. Tu prometeste esta coisa boa a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.

decisions.choice: you are God: you and no other
decisions.reason: The words, literally "you, he is the God", stress that Yahweh is the one true God (Deuteronomy 4:35; 1 Kings 18:39).

decisions.choice: truth: true and reliable
decisions.reason: The word means what is firm and can be trusted. Yahweh's words will prove true; what he promises he will do.

decisions.choice: this good thing: the promised blessing
decisions.reason: "Good" here is the good that Yahweh has promised: the lasting house (compare 1 Samuel 25:30).

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: As in verse 18.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאֵל֙ וּבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָ֣תְךָ֔ יְבֹרַ֥ךְ בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And now, be willing and bless [the] house of your servant to be forever before you; for you, my Lord Yahweh, have spoken, and from your blessing will be blessed [the] house of your servant forever.

en.L: And now, be pleased to bless the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, so that it may be forever before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, have spoken, and with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} blessing the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant will be blessed forever."
en.B: So now, be willing to bless the house of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, so that it may last before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever. For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, have spoken, and by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} blessing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant's house will be blessed forever."
en.R: So now, please bless my family, so that it will last forever in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence. {{divine_name:Lord GOD|Lord Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have promised it. Because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bless it, my family will be blessed forever."

es.L: Y ahora, dígnate bendecir la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, para que esté para siempre delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, has hablado, y con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bendición será bendita la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo para siempre».
es.B: Así que ahora, ten a bien bendecir la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, para que permanezca delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para siempre. Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, lo has dicho, y con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bendición la casa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo será bendita para siempre».
es.R: Así que ahora, te ruego que bendigas a mi familia, para que dure para siempre en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} presencia. Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo has prometido. Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} la bendices, mi familia será bendita para siempre».

fr.L: Et maintenant, veuille bénir la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, afin qu’elle soit pour toujours devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, qui as parlé, et par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bénédiction la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur sera bénie pour toujours. »
fr.B: Maintenant donc, daigne bénir la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, afin qu’elle subsiste pour toujours devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, qui as parlé, et grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bénédiction la maison de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur sera bénie pour toujours. »
fr.R: Alors maintenant, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, bénis ma famille, pour qu’elle dure toujours devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui l’as promis. Parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} la bénis, ma famille sera bénie pour toujours. »

sw.L: Basi sasa, upende kuibariki nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili iwe milele mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, umesema, na kwa baraka {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} itabarikiwa milele."
sw.B: Basi sasa, uwe radhi kuibariki nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili idumu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} milele. Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, umesema, na kwa baraka {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nyumba ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} itabarikiwa milele."
sw.R: Basi sasa, tafadhali ibariki jamaa yangu, ili idumu milele mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umeahidi hivyo. Kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaibariki, jamaa yangu itabarikiwa milele."

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng ban phước cho nhà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để nhà ấy còn mãi mãi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán, và nhờ phước lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ được phước đời đời."
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng ban phước cho nhà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để nhà ấy được còn mãi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán, và nhờ phước lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ được phước đời đời."
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, xin ban phước cho gia đình con, để gia đình con được tồn tại mãi mãi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Lạy Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa như vậy. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban phước, gia đình con sẽ được phước đời đời."

ko.L: 그리고 이제 기꺼이 주님의 종의 집에 복을 주셔서, 그것이 주님 앞에 영원히 있게 해 주십시오. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서 말씀하셨으니, 주님의 복으로 주님의 종의 집이 영원히 복을 받을 것입니다."
ko.B: 그러니 이제 기꺼이 주님의 종의 집안에 복을 주셔서, 그 집안이 주님 앞에서 영원히 이어지게 해 주십시오. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서 말씀하셨으니, 주님의 복으로 주님의 종의 집안이 영원히 복을 받을 것입니다."
ko.R: 그러니 이제 제 집안에 복을 주셔서, 제 집안이 주님 앞에서 영원히 이어지게 해 주십시오. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 주님께서 그렇게 약속하셨습니다. 주님께서 복을 주시니, 제 집안이 영원히 복을 받을 것입니다."

pt.L: E agora, consente em abençoar a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, para que ela esteja para sempre diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, falaste, e com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} bênção a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo será abençoada para sempre."
pt.B: Agora, pois, tem a bondade de abençoar a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, para que ela dure para sempre diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, falaste, e pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} bênção a casa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo será abençoada para sempre."
pt.R: Agora, por favor, abençoa a minha família, para que ela dure para sempre na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} presença. Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prometeste isso. Porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} a abençoas, a minha família será abençoada para sempre."

decisions.choice: be pleased: a polite request
decisions.reason: The verb means to be willing or to agree to do something. It is a respectful way to ask.

decisions.choice: will be blessed: confidence, not only a wish
alternatives: let the house of your servant be blessed forever
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as a wish, "let it be blessed", but after "you have spoken" it is best read as David's confidence: what Yahweh has promised will happen.

decisions.choice: bless ... blessing ... blessed: the prayer ends where the promise ended
decisions.reason: The word for blessing comes three times, and the prayer closes, like Nathan's message (verse 16), on David's house lasting forever.

decisions.choice: Lord GOD
decisions.reason: As in verse 18.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: my family
decisions.reason: Readable says "my family" for "the house of your servant".
